                      onClick={() => setNoteOpen((o) => !o)}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-[#9CA3AF] hover:text-cyan-700 dark:hover:text-cyan-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <StickyNote className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-500" />
                      <span>
                        {cardNotes[activeCard.id]
                          ? 'Моя заметка / мнемоника (сохранена)'
                          : 'Добавить личную заметку / мнемонику'}
                      </span>
                    </button>

                    {(noteOpen || Boolean(cardNotes[activeCard.id])) && (
                      <textarea
                        rows={2}
                        value={cardNotes[activeCard.id] ?? ''}
                        onChange={(e) => onSaveCardNote(activeCard.id, e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Ваша ассоциация, мнемоника или короткая пометка (сохраняется автоматически)..."
                        className="prism-input mt-2 w-full px-3.5 py-2 text-xs rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] placeholder:text-slate-400 dark:placeholder:text-[#64748B]"
                      />
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* d) Calm SM-2 Bottom Rating Strip (Neutral at rest -> Vivid Distinct Color on Hover/Selection) */}
                <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-slate-200/70 dark:border-white/[0.07]">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">
                      Оценка ответа SM-2 (клавиши 1–4):
                    </span>
                    {evaluation && (
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300">
                        Рекомендовано: {GRADE_LABELS[evaluation.recommendedGrade]}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                    {/* 1 · Не помню -> CRIMSON / ROSE */}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleGradeClick('again')}
                      className={`group min-h-[52px] flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-3 py-2 rounded-2xl border text-center transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                        evaluation?.recommendedGrade === 'again'
                          ? 'border-rose-500/60 bg-rose-500/14'
                          : activeSR?.lastGrade === 'again'
                            ? 'border-rose-500/45 bg-rose-500/10'
                            : 'border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.12] bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-[#121926] hover:border-rose-500/50 hover:bg-rose-500/10'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#F1F5F9] group-hover:text-rose-600 dark:group-hover:text-rose-300 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500/90" />
                        <span>1 · Не помню</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-mono tabular-nums text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8] whitespace-nowrap">
                        сейчас · 15%
                      </span>
                    </button>

                    {/* 2 · Сложно -> AMBER */}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleGradeClick('hard')}
                      className={`group min-h-[52px] flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-3 py-2 rounded-2xl border text-center transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                        evaluation?.recommendedGrade === 'hard'
                          ? 'border-amber-500/60 bg-amber-500/14'
                          : activeSR?.lastGrade === 'hard'
                            ? 'border-amber-500/45 bg-amber-500/10'
                            : 'border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.12] bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-[#121926] hover:border-amber-500/50 hover:bg-amber-500/10'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#F1F5F9] group-hover:text-amber-600 dark:group-hover:text-amber-300 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400/90" />
                        <span>2 · Сложно</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-mono tabular-nums text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8] whitespace-nowrap">
                        10 мин · 42%
                      </span>
                    </button>

                    {/* 3 · Хорошо -> CYAN */}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleGradeClick('good')}
                      className={`group min-h-[52px] flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-3 py-2 rounded-2xl border text-center transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                        evaluation?.recommendedGrade === 'good'
                          ? 'border-cyan-400/60 bg-cyan-500/14'
                          : activeSR?.lastGrade === 'good'
                            ? 'border-cyan-400/45 bg-cyan-500/10'
                            : 'border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.12] bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-[#121926] hover:border-cyan-400/50 hover:bg-cyan-500/10'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#F1F5F9] group-hover:text-cyan-600 dark:group-hover:text-cyan-300 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-400/90" />
                        <span>3 · Хорошо</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-mono tabular-nums text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8] whitespace-nowrap">
                        1–3 дн. · 72%+
                      </span>
                    </button>

                    {/* 4 · Легко -> EMERALD */}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleGradeClick('easy')}
                      className={`group min-h-[52px] flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-3 py-2 rounded-2xl border text-center transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                        evaluation?.recommendedGrade === 'easy'
                          ? 'prism-tab-active'
                          : activeSR?.lastGrade === 'easy'
                            ? 'border-emerald-400/45 bg-emerald-500/10'
                            : 'border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.12] bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-[#121926] hover:border-emerald-400/50 hover:bg-emerald-500/10'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#F1F5F9] group-hover:text-emerald-600 dark:group-hover:text-emerald-300 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400/90" />
                        <span>4 · Легко</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-mono tabular-nums text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8] whitespace-nowrap">
                        4+ дн. · 96%+
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </article>
            </div>

            {/* Right Zone: Sticky Source Slides Panel (Stable Position, Maximized Width for Reading) */}
            <aside className="lg:col-span-5 lg:sticky lg:top-20 flex flex-col min-w-0 prism-surface rounded-[20px] p-4 sm:p-5">
              {!revealed ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-200/70 dark:border-white/[0.08]">
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
                      Слайды конспекта к билету
                    </span>
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-mono tabular-nums bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#121926] border border-slate-200/70 dark:border-white/[0.1] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#CBD5E1]">
                      {activeCard.slides.length} шт.
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300/80 dark:border-white/[0.12] bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#070B12]/55 p-6 text-center space-y-3.5 min-h-[260px]">
                    <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-[#121926] border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.1] flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                      <EyeOff className="h-5 w-5" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1.5 max-w-xs">
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
                        Слайды скрыты до переворота карточки
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#9CA3AF] leading-relaxed">
                        Сначала попробуйте вспомнить ответ сами — затем откройте эталон и оригинальные слайды лекции.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setRevealed(true)}
                      className="prism-tool-btn inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full text-slate-800 dark:text-[#F1F5F9] cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" />
                      <span>Открыть ответ и слайды</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {activeCard.slides.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="space-y-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200/70 dark:border-white/[0.08]">
                      <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                        Прикреплённые материалы:
                      </p>
                      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                        {activeCard.slides.slice(0, 4).map((sl, i) => (
                          <div
                            key={`${sl.lectureId}-${sl.page}-${i}`}
                            className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-[#121926] border border-slate-200/70 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-800 dark:text-[#CBD5E1]"
                          >
                            <span className="leading-snug break-words">{sl.label}</span>
                            <span className="font-mono tabular-nums text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-cyan-300/90 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0">
                              с.{sl.page}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <SlideAttachmentsPanel
                  slides={activeCard.slides}
                  heading="Слайды из лекций к вопросу"
                  compact
                  defaultHidden={true}
                />
              )}
            </aside>
          </div>

          {/* Full-Width Muted Navigator Grid (Low-Glare Tiles So Card Text Stays Primary) */}
          <section className="prism-surface rounded-[20px] p-5">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-3.5">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
                  Навигатор по карточкам ({filteredCards.length})
                </h3>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500/80" />
                    Не помню
                  </span>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400/80" />
                    Сложно
                  </span>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-400/80" />
                    Хорошо
                  </span>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400/80" />
                    Выучено
                  </span>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-[#CBD5E1]">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-400/80 via-emerald-400/80 to-cyan-400/80" />
                    95%+
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono tabular-nums text-slate-500 dark:text-[#64748B]">
                ← / → или свайп
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-8 sm:grid-cols-12 md:grid-cols-16 lg:grid-cols-18 gap-1.5">
              {filteredCards.map((card) => {
                const sr = getCardSRState(srMap, card.id);
                const masteryPct = getCardMasteryPercent(sr);
                const tier = getCardVisualTier(sr);
                const isActive = card.id === activeCard.id;

                let tone =
                  'border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-100/75 dark:bg-[#101724] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8] hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-white/25 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-[#F1F5F9]';
                let dotColor = '';

                if (tier === 'rainbow') {
                  tone = 'rainbow-mastered-tile font-semibold';
                  dotColor = 'bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-400/85 via-emerald-400/85 to-cyan-400/85';
                } else if (tier === 'known') {
                  tone =
                    'border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/[0.08] text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300/85 hover:border-emerald-400/40';
                  dotColor = 'bg-emerald-400/85';
                } else if (tier === 'learning') {
                  tone =
                    'border-cyan-500/20 bg-cyan-500/[0.08] text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300/85 hover:border-cyan-400/40';
                  dotColor = 'bg-cyan-400/85';
                } else if (tier === 'hard') {
                  tone =
                    'border-amber-500/22 bg-amber-500/[0.08] text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300/85 hover:border-amber-400/45';
                  dotColor = 'bg-amber-400/85';
                } else if (tier === 'again') {
                  tone =
                    'border-rose-500/22 bg-rose-500/[0.08] text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300/85 hover:border-rose-400/45';
                  dotColor = 'bg-rose-500/85';
                }

                const navLabel =
                  card.id >= 201 && card.id <= 224
                    ? `${card.id - 200}`
                    : card.id >= 225 && card.id <= 232
                      ? `П${card.id - 224}`
                      : card.id >= 233 && card.id <= 249
                        ? `З${card.id - 232}`
                        : card.id >= 501 && card.id <= 549
                          ? `В${card.id - 500}`
                          : card.id >= 551 && card.id <= 598
                            ? `О${card.id - 550}`
                            : card.id >= 601 && card.id <= 618
                              ? `М${card.id - 600}`
                              : `${card.id}`;

                return (
                  <button
                    key={card.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onSelectQuestionId(card.id)}
                    title={`${card.badgeLabel ?? `№${card.id}`} (${masteryPct}%): ${card.question}`}
                    className={`relative h-8 rounded-lg border text-xs font-mono tabular-nums font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer ${tone} ${
                      isActive ? 'dt-active-tile font-bold z-10' : ''
                    }`}
                  >
                    {navLabel}
                    {isActive && dotColor && (
                      <span
                        className={`absolute top-1 right-1 h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${dotColor}`}
                      />
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </section>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import {useMemo, useState} from 'react';

type SheetTab = 'matan' | 'rk' | 'exam' | 'weak_print';

  {

    latex:

    note: 'Если rg A = n — единственное решение; если rg A = r < n — бесконечно много (n−r свободных).',

  },

    code: '#ifndef MY_HEADER_H\n#define MY_HEADER_H\n...\n#endif\n// Двоичный: fread/fwrite | Текстовый безопасный: fgets(buf, size, f)',

  },

export function FormulaCheatSheetModal({
  category,
  subjectTitle,
  allCards,
  srMap,
  onClose,
}: FormulaCheatSheetModalProps) {
  const initialTab: SheetTab =
    category === 'rk'
      ? 'rk'
      : category === 'exam'
        ? 'exam'
        : category === 'matan'
          ? 'matan'
          : 'weak_print';
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<SheetTab>(initialTab);
  const [printScope, setPrintScope] = useState<'weak' | 'all_with_formulas'>(
    'weak',
  );

  const weakCards = useMemo(() => {
    const scored = allCards.map((card) => {
      const sr = getCardSRState(srMap, card.id);
      const priority =
        sr.status === 'hard'
          ? 100 + sr.lapses * 20
          : sr.status === 'unseen'
            ? 60
            : sr.status === 'learning'
              ? 40 + sr.lapses * 10
              : 0;
      return {card, sr, priority};
    });
    const nonKnown = scored
      .filter((x) => x.sr.status !== 'known')
      .sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority);
    if (nonKnown.length > 0) {
      return nonKnown.slice(0, 30);
    }
    return scored.slice(0, 20);
  }, [allCards, srMap]);

  const formulaCards = useMemo(
    () =>
      allCards
        .filter((c) => Boolean(c.mathFormulaLatex) || Boolean(c.codeSnippet))
        .slice(0, 40),
    [allCards],
  );

  const cardsToPrint =
    printScope === 'weak'
      ? weakCards.map((w) => w.card)
      : formulaCards.length > 0
        ? formulaCards
        : allCards.slice(0, 30);

  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#04070D]/80 backdrop-blur-md p-2 sm:p-4 overflow-y-auto">
      {/* Interactive Modal UI (hidden on print via no-print) */}
      <div className="no-print w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#0E1522] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <BookOpen className="h-5 w-5 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400 shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                Справочник формул и печать шпаргалки (PDF)
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                Компактные таблицы формул KaTeX + лист ваших слабых карточек для печати
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePrint}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg prism-cta transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Printer className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Печать / Сохранить PDF</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Закрыть справочник"
              className="p-2 rounded-lg text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="px-5 py-2.5 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#0B101B] flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          {(
            [
              {id: 'matan', label: 'Матан (формулы и Тейлор)'},
              {id: 'rk', label: 'Ангем РК 2 (матрицы и СЛАУ)'},
              {id: 'exam', label: 'АИП (C/C++ и ГОСТ)'},
              {
                id: 'weak_print',
                label: `Лист слабых карточек (${weakCards.length})`,
              },
            ] as const
          ).map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTab(t.id)}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                tab === t.id
                  ? 'prism-cta'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-[#94A3B8] dark:hover:text-[#F3F4F6]'
              }`}
            >
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 space-y-6">
          {tab === 'matan' && (
            <>
              <section className="space-y-3">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                  1. Таблица эквивалентных бесконечно малых (при x → 0)
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                  {MATAN_EQUIVALENTS.map((row) => (
                    <div
                      key={row.name}
                      className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#0B101B] p-3.5"
                    >
                      <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">
                        {row.name}
                      </p>
                      <MathBlock latex={row.latex} displayMode={true} />
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                        {row.note}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </section>

              <section className="space-y-3">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                  2. Разложения Маклорена с остатком в форме Пеано
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                  {MATAN_MACLAURIN.map((row) => (
                    <div
                      key={row.name}
                      className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#0B101B] p-3.5"
                    >
                      <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">
                        {row.name}

                      <MathBlock latex={row.latex} displayMode={true} />

                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </section>

              <section className="space-y-3">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                  3. Производные, Лейбниц, асимптоты и разрывы
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                  {MATAN_DERIVATIVES_AND_STUDY.map((row) => (
                    <div
                      key={row.name}
                      className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#0B101B] p-3.5"
                    >
                      <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">
                        {row.name}
                      </p>
                      <MathBlock latex={row.latex} displayMode={true} />
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                        {row.note}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </section>
            </>
          )}

          {tab === 'rk' && (
            <section className="space-y-3">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                Ключевые формулы РК 2 (Матрицы, Определители, СЛАУ, ФСР)
              </h3>
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                {RK_FORMULAS.map((row) => (
                  <div
                    key={row.name}
                    className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#0B101B] p-3.5"
                  >
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">
                      {row.name}
                    </p>
                    <MathBlock latex={row.latex} displayMode={true} />
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                      {row.note}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>
          )}

          {tab === 'exam' && (
            <section className="space-y-3">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                Шпаргалка по АИП (C/C++, память, деревья, файлы)
              </h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {EXAM_AIP_ROWS.map((row) => (
                  <div
                    key={row.title}

                  >
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">
                      {row.title}

                    <pre className="p-2.5 rounded-md bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 text-xs font-mono overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre-wrap">
                      <code>{row.code}</code>

                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                      {row.note}

                  </div>
                ))}

          {tab === 'weak_print' && (
            <section className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border border-sky-200 dark:border-sky-800/60 bg-sky-50/60 dark:bg-sky-950/20 p-3.5">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-sky-900 dark:text-sky-300">

                  <button

                  >

                      {card.question}

                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
                      {card.keyThesis}

                        Ловушка: {card.examTip}

      {/* Dedicated Clean Printable Sheet (visible ONLY when printing to paper / PDF) */}
      <div className="print-only w-full bg-white text-black p-4 space-y-5">
        <div className="border-b-2 border-black pb-2 flex items-baseline justify-between">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">
            Шпаргалка: {subjectTitle} (
            {tab === 'weak_print'
              ? printScope === 'weak'
                ? 'Слабые и невыученные карточки'

              : tab === 'matan'

                : tab === 'rk'

                  : 'Справочник АИП C/C++'}
            )
          </h1>
          <span className="text-xs font-mono">
            {new Date().toLocaleDateString('ru-RU')}
          </span>
        </div>

        {tab === 'matan' && (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {[
              ...MATAN_EQUIVALENTS,
              ...MATAN_MACLAURIN,
              ...MATAN_DERIVATIVES_AND_STUDY,
            ].map((row) => (
              <div
                key={row.name}
                className="print-break-avoid border border-slate-300 rounded p-2.5"

                <div className="text-xs font-bold">{row.name}</div>

                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-700">{row.note}</div>

            ))}
          </div>

        {tab === 'rk' && (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {RK_FORMULAS.map((row) => (
              <div
                key={row.name}
                className="print-break-avoid border border-slate-300 rounded p-2.5"
              >
                <div className="text-xs font-bold">{row.name}</div>
                <MathBlock latex={row.latex} displayMode={true} className="!text-black" />

        {tab === 'exam' && (

              >
                <div className="text-xs font-bold">{row.title}</div>
                <pre className="text-[11px] font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap mt-1">
                  {row.code}
                </pre>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-700 mt-1">{row.note}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {tab === 'weak_print' && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {cardsToPrint.map((card) => (
              <div
                key={card.id}
                className="print-break-avoid border border-slate-300 rounded p-2.5 space-y-1"
              >
                <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-600">
                  №{card.id} · {card.chapter}
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs font-bold">{card.question}</div>
                <div className="text-[11px]">{card.keyThesis}</div>
                {card.mathFormulaLatex && (
                  <MathBlock
                    latex={card.mathFormulaLatex}
                    displayMode={false}
                    className="!text-black"
                  />
                )}
                {card.examTip && (
                  <div className="text-[10px] italic text-slate-700">
                    Ловушка: {card.examTip}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import {MouseEvent, useMemo, useState} from 'react';
import {Activity} from 'lucide-react';
import {MathBlock} from './MathBlock';

interface FunctionGraphCardProps {
  taskId: string;
}

interface MarkedPoint {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  label: string;
  kind: 'extremum' | 'inflection';
}

interface MatanGraphSpec {
  title: string;
  latex: string;
  fn: (x: number) => number;
  xRange: [number, number];
  yRange: [number, number];
  verticalAsymptotes: number[];
  obliqueAsymptote?: {k: number; b: number; label: string};
  points: MarkedPoint[];
  summary: string;
}

const SQRT2 = Math.SQRT2;
const CBRT4 = Math.cbrt(4);

const MATAN_GRAPH_SPECS: Record<string, MatanGraphSpec> = {
  'matan-5-1': {
    title: 'График исследования f(x) = x⁴ / (x³ − 1)',
    latex: 'f(x) = \\dfrac{x^4}{x^3 - 1}',
    fn: (x) => (Math.abs(x - 1) < 0.025 ? Number.NaN : x ** 4 / (x ** 3 - 1)),
    xRange: [-4.5, 5.5],
    yRange: [-5, 7],
    verticalAsymptotes: [1],
    obliqueAsymptote: {k: 1, b: 0, label: 'y = x'},
    points: [
      {x: 0, y: 0, label: 'max (0; 0)', kind: 'extremum'},
      {
        x: CBRT4,
        y: (4 * CBRT4) / 3,
        label: 'min (∛4; 4∛4/3)',
        kind: 'extremum',
      },
    ],
    summary:
      'Вертикальная асимптота x = 1, наклонная y = x. Локальный max в (0; 0), локальный min в (∛4 ≈ 1.59; 2.12).',
  },
  'matan-5-2': {
    title: 'График f(x) = ln(1 + x²) — экстремумы и выпуклость',
    latex: 'f(x) = \\ln(1 + x^2)',
    fn: (x) => Math.log(1 + x * x),
    xRange: [-4.5, 4.5],
    yRange: [-0.8, 3.6],
    verticalAsymptotes: [],
    points: [
      {x: 0, y: 0, label: 'min (0; 0)', kind: 'extremum'},
      {x: -1, y: Math.LN2, label: 'перегиб (−1; ln 2)', kind: 'inflection'},
      {x: 1, y: Math.LN2, label: 'перегиб (1; ln 2)', kind: 'inflection'},
    ],
    summary:
      'Чётная функция без асимптот. Минимум в (0; 0); выпукла вниз на (−1; 1), выпукла вверх при |x| > 1; точки перегиба (±1; ln 2).',
  },
  'matan-5-3': {
    title: 'График f(x) = ln(1 + x²) — интервалы выпуклости и перегибы',
    latex: 'f(x) = \\ln(1 + x^2)',
    fn: (x) => Math.log(1 + x * x),
    xRange: [-4.5, 4.5],
    yRange: [-0.8, 3.6],
    verticalAsymptotes: [],
    points: [
      {x: 0, y: 0, label: 'min (0; 0)', kind: 'extremum'},
      {x: -1, y: Math.LN2, label: 'перегиб (−1; ln 2)', kind: 'inflection'},
      {x: 1, y: Math.LN2, label: 'перегиб (1; ln 2)', kind: 'inflection'},
    ],
    summary:
      'Вторая производная f\'\'(x) = 2(1 − x²)/(1 + x²)² меняет знак в точках x = −1 и x = 1.',
  },
  'matan-5-4': {
    title: 'График f(x) = x² / (2(x − 1))',
    latex: 'f(x) = \\dfrac{x^2}{2(x - 1)}',
    fn: (x) =>
      Math.abs(x - 1) < 0.025 ? Number.NaN : (x * x) / (2 * (x - 1)),
    xRange: [-4, 6],
    yRange: [-4.5, 6.5],
    verticalAsymptotes: [1],
    obliqueAsymptote: {k: 0.5, b: 0.5, label: 'y = 0.5x + 0.5'},
    points: [
      {x: 0, y: 0, label: 'max (0; 0)', kind: 'extremum'},
      {x: 2, y: 2, label: 'min (2; 2)', kind: 'extremum'},
    ],
    summary:
      'Вертикальная асимптота x = 1, наклонная y = x/2 + 1/2. Локальный max (0; 0), локальный min (2; 2).',
  },
  'matan-5-5': {
    title: 'График f(x) = (x² + 1) / x',
    latex: 'f(x) = \\dfrac{x^2 + 1}{x} = x + \\dfrac{1}{x}',
    fn: (x) => (Math.abs(x) < 0.025 ? Number.NaN : (x * x + 1) / x),
    xRange: [-5, 5],
    yRange: [-6, 6],
    verticalAsymptotes: [0],
    obliqueAsymptote: {k: 1, b: 0, label: 'y = x'},
    points: [
      {x: -1, y: -2, label: 'max (−1; −2)', kind: 'extremum'},
      {x: 1, y: 2, label: 'min (1; 2)', kind: 'extremum'},
    ],
    summary:
      'Нечётная функция: вертикальная асимптота x = 0, наклонная y = x. Локальный max (−1; −2), локальный min (1; 2).',
  },
  'matan-5-6': {
    title: 'График f(x) = (x² + 1) / (x − 1)',
    latex: 'f(x) = \\dfrac{x^2 + 1}{x - 1}',
    fn: (x) => (Math.abs(x - 1) < 0.025 ? Number.NaN : (x * x + 1) / (x - 1)),
    xRange: [-4, 6],
    yRange: [-5.5, 8.5],
    verticalAsymptotes: [1],
    obliqueAsymptote: {k: 1, b: 1, label: 'y = x + 1'},
    points: [
      {
        x: 1 - SQRT2,
        y: 2 - 2 * SQRT2,
        label: 'max (1−√2; 2−2√2)',
        kind: 'extremum',
      },
      {
        x: 1 + SQRT2,
        y: 2 + 2 * SQRT2,
        label: 'min (1+√2; 2+2√2)',
        kind: 'extremum',
      },
    ],
    summary:
      'Вертикальная асимптота x = 1, наклонная y = x + 1. Локальный max ≈ (−0.41; −0.83), локальный min ≈ (2.41; 4.83).',
  },
};

export function hasMatanGraph(taskId: string): boolean {
  return Boolean(MATAN_GRAPH_SPECS[taskId]);
}

const SVG_W = 640;
const SVG_H = 340;
const PAD = 36;

export function FunctionGraphCard({taskId}: FunctionGraphCardProps) {
  const spec = MATAN_GRAPH_SPECS[taskId];
  const [showAsymptotes, setShowAsymptotes] = useState(true);
  const [showExtrema, setShowExtrema] = useState(true);
  const [showInflections, setShowInflections] = useState(true);
  const [hoverX, setHoverX] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const [xMin, xMax] = spec ? spec.xRange : [-5, 5];
  const [yMin, yMax] = spec ? spec.yRange : [-5, 5];

  const toSvgX = (x: number) =>
    PAD + ((x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * (SVG_W - PAD * 2);
  const toSvgY = (y: number) =>
    SVG_H - PAD - ((y - yMin) / (yMax - yMin)) * (SVG_H - PAD * 2);

  const curvePaths = useMemo(() => {
    if (!spec) return [];
    const paths: string[] = [];
    const samples = 520;
    let currentD = '';
    let prevY: number | null = null;

    for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i++) {
      const x = xMin + (i / samples) * (xMax - xMin);
      const y = spec.fn(x);
      const isJump =
        prevY !== null &&
        Math.abs(y - prevY) > (yMax - yMin) * 0.45;

      if (
        !Number.isFinite(y) ||
        y < yMin - 1.2 ||
        y > yMax + 1.2 ||
        isJump
      ) {
        if (currentD) {
          paths.push(currentD);
          currentD = '';
        }
        prevY = null;
        continue;
      }

      const sx = toSvgX(x).toFixed(1);
      const sy = toSvgY(y).toFixed(1);
      currentD += currentD ? ` L ${sx} ${sy}` : `M ${sx} ${sy}`;
      prevY = y;
    }
    if (currentD) paths.push(currentD);
    return paths;
  }, [spec, xMin, xMax, yMin, yMax]);

  if (!spec) return null;

  const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const relX = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * SVG_W;
    if (relX < PAD || relX > SVG_W - PAD) {
      setHoverX(null);
      return;
    }
    const mathX = xMin + ((relX - PAD) / (SVG_W - PAD * 2)) * (xMax - xMin);
    setHoverX(mathX);
  };

  const hoverY = hoverX !== null ? spec.fn(hoverX) : Number.NaN;
  const hoverValid =
    hoverX !== null &&
    Number.isFinite(hoverY) &&
    hoverY >= yMin &&
    hoverY <= yMax;

  const xTicks: number[] = [];
  for (let x = Math.ceil(xMin); x <= Math.floor(xMax); x++) {
    if (x !== 0) xTicks.push(x);
  }
  const yTicks: number[] = [];
  for (let y = Math.ceil(yMin); y <= Math.floor(yMax); y++) {
    if (y !== 0) yTicks.push(y);
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-sky-200 dark:border-sky-800/60 bg-white dark:bg-[#0B101B] p-4 space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Activity className="h-4 w-4 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400" />
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
            {spec.title}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
          <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={showAsymptotes}
              onChange={(e) => setShowAsymptotes(e.target.checked)}
              className="accent-rose-500"
            />
            <span>Асимптоты</span>
          </label>
          <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={showExtrema}
              onChange={(e) => setShowExtrema(e.target.checked)}
              className="accent-emerald-500"
            />
            <span>Экстремумы</span>
          </label>
          {spec.points.some((p) => p.kind === 'inflection') && (
            <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={showInflections}
                onChange={(e) => setShowInflections(e.target.checked)}
                className="accent-amber-500"
              />
              <span>Перегибы</span>
            </label>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2">
        <MathBlock latex={spec.latex} displayMode={false} />
        <span className="text-xs font-mono tabular-nums text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">
          {hoverValid && hoverX !== null
            ? `x = ${hoverX.toFixed(2)},  f(x) = ${hoverY.toFixed(2)}`
            : 'Наведите на график для координат (x, f(x))'}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#101010]">
        <svg
          viewBox={`0 0 ${SVG_W} ${SVG_H}`}
          className="w-full h-auto block select-none"
          onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
          onMouseLeave={() => setHoverX(null)}
        >
          <defs>
            <clipPath id={`plot-clip-${taskId}`}>
              <rect
                x={PAD}
                y={PAD}
                width={SVG_W - PAD * 2}
                height={SVG_H - PAD * 2}
              />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>

          {/* Grid lines */}
          {xTicks.map((x) => (
            <line
              key={`gx-${x}`}
              x1={toSvgX(x)}
              y1={PAD}
              x2={toSvgX(x)}
              y2={SVG_H - PAD}
              stroke="currentColor"
              className="text-slate-200 dark:text-slate-800"
              strokeWidth={1}
            />
          ))}
          {yTicks.map((y) => (
            <line
              key={`gy-${y}`}
              x1={PAD}
              y1={toSvgY(y)}
              x2={SVG_W - PAD}
              y2={toSvgY(y)}
              stroke="currentColor"
              className="text-slate-200 dark:text-slate-800"
              strokeWidth={1}
            />
          ))}

          {/* Axes */}
          {yMin <= 0 && yMax >= 0 && (
            <line
              x1={PAD}
              y1={toSvgY(0)}
              x2={SVG_W - PAD}
              y2={toSvgY(0)}
              stroke="currentColor"
              className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"
              strokeWidth={1.5}
            />
          )}
          {xMin <= 0 && xMax >= 0 && (
            <line
              x1={toSvgX(0)}
              y1={PAD}
              x2={toSvgX(0)}
              y2={SVG_H - PAD}
              stroke="currentColor"
              className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"
              strokeWidth={1.5}
            />
          )}

          {/* Tick labels */}
          {xTicks.map((x) => (
            <text
              key={`tx-${x}`}
              x={toSvgX(x)}
              y={Math.min(SVG_H - PAD + 14, toSvgY(0) + 14)}
              textAnchor="middle"
              className="fill-slate-500 dark:fill-slate-400 text-[10px] font-mono"
            >
              {x}
            </text>
          ))}
          {yTicks.map((y) => (
            <text
              key={`ty-${y}`}
              x={Math.max(PAD - 6, toSvgX(0) - 6)}
              y={toSvgY(y) + 3}
              textAnchor="end"
              className="fill-slate-500 dark:fill-slate-400 text-[10px] font-mono"
            >
              {y}
            </text>
          ))}

          <g clipPath={`url(#plot-clip-${taskId})`}>
            {/* Asymptotes */}
            {showAsymptotes &&
              spec.verticalAsymptotes.map((ax) => (
                <g key={`va-${ax}`}>
                  <line
                    x1={toSvgX(ax)}
                    y1={PAD}
                    x2={toSvgX(ax)}
                    y2={SVG_H - PAD}
                    stroke="#e11d48"
                    strokeWidth={1.5}
                    strokeDasharray="6 4"
                  />
                  <text
                    x={toSvgX(ax) + 5}
                    y={PAD + 14}
                    className="fill-rose-600 dark:fill-rose-400 text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold"
                  >
                    x = {ax}
                  </text>
                </g>
              ))}

            {showAsymptotes && spec.obliqueAsymptote && (
              <g>
                <line
                  x1={toSvgX(xMin)}
                  y1={toSvgY(
                    spec.obliqueAsymptote.k * xMin + spec.obliqueAsymptote.b,
                  )}
                  x2={toSvgX(xMax)}
                  y2={toSvgY(
                    spec.obliqueAsymptote.k * xMax + spec.obliqueAsymptote.b,
                  )}
                  stroke="#f97316"
                  strokeWidth={1.5}
                  strokeDasharray="6 4"
                />
                <text
                  x={SVG_W - PAD - 72}
                  y={PAD + 14}
                  className="fill-orange-600 dark:fill-orange-400 text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold"
                >
                  {spec.obliqueAsymptote.label}
                </text>
              </g>
            )}

            {/* Function curves */}
            {curvePaths.map((d, idx) => (
              <path
                key={idx}
                d={d}
                fill="none"
                stroke="#0284c7"
                strokeWidth={2.5}
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              />
            ))}

            {/* Marked extrema & inflection points */}
            {spec.points.map((pt) => {
              if (pt.kind === 'extremum' && !showExtrema) return null;
              if (pt.kind === 'inflection' && !showInflections) return null;
              const cx = toSvgX(pt.x);
              const cy = toSvgY(pt.y);
              const fill = pt.kind === 'extremum' ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b';
              return (
                <g key={pt.label}>
                  <circle
                    cx={cx}
                    cy={cy}
                    r={4.5}
                    fill={fill}
                    stroke="#ffffff"
                    strokeWidth={1.5}
                  />
                  <text
                    x={cx + 7}
                    y={cy - 7}
                    className="fill-slate-900 dark:fill-slate-100 text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold"
                  >
                    {pt.label}
                  </text>
                </g>
              );
            })}

            {/* Hover crosshair */}
            {hoverValid && hoverX !== null && (
              <g>
                <line
                  x1={toSvgX(hoverX)}
                  y1={PAD}
                  x2={toSvgX(hoverX)}
                  y2={SVG_H - PAD}
                  stroke="#38bdf8"
                  strokeWidth={1}
                  strokeDasharray="3 3"
                />
                <circle
                  cx={toSvgX(hoverX)}
                  cy={toSvgY(hoverY)}
                  r={4.5}
                  fill="#0284c7"
                  stroke="#ffffff"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                />
              </g>
            )}
          </g>
        </svg>
      </div>

      <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
        {spec.summary}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

/* Shared SVG helper shapes conforming to GOST 19.701-90 */
function SvgDefs() {
  return (
    <defs>
      <marker
        id="gost-arrow"
        viewBox="0 0 10 10"
        refX="8"
        refY="5"
        markerWidth="6"
        markerHeight="6"
        orient="auto-start-reverse"
      >
        <path d="M 0 1.5 L 8 5 L 0 8.5 z" className="fill-slate-600 dark:fill-slate-400" />
      </marker>
    </defs>
  );
}

function Terminator({x, y, text}: {x: number; y: number; text: string}) {
  return (
    <g>
      <rect
        x={x - 95}
        y={y}
        width="190"
        height="36"
        rx="18"
        className="fill-white dark:fill-slate-900 stroke-slate-700 dark:stroke-slate-300"
        strokeWidth="1.5"
      />
      <text
        x={x}
        y={y + 22}
        textAnchor="middle"
        className="fill-slate-900 dark:fill-slate-100 text-[12px] font-medium"
      >
        {text}
      </text>
    </g>
  );
}

function IoBox({x, y, lines}: {x: number; y: number; lines: string[]}) {
  const h = lines.length > 1 ? 46 : 38;
  const pts = `${x - 105},${y} ${x + 120},${y} ${x + 105},${y + h} ${x - 120},${y + h}`;
  return (
    <g>
      <polygon
        points={pts}
        className="fill-white dark:fill-slate-900 stroke-slate-700 dark:stroke-slate-300"
        strokeWidth="1.5"
      />
      {lines.map((line, i) => (

          y={y + (lines.length > 1 ? 18 + i * 16 : 23)}
          textAnchor="middle"
          className="fill-slate-900 dark:fill-slate-100 text-[12px]"
        >
          {line}
        </text>
      ))}
    </g>
  );
}

function PredefinedBox({x, y, lines}: {x: number; y: number; lines: string[]}) {
  const h = lines.length > 1 ? 46 : 38;
  return (

        x={x - 115}

      <line

        y1={y}
        x2={x + 103}

      />

      ))}
