```tsx
import {ChangeEvent, useEffect, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  Camera,
  CheckCircle2,
  Loader2,
  Sparkles,
  Upload,
  XCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface PhotoCheckResult {
  verdict: 'correct' | 'partial' | 'wrong';
  verdictTitle: string;
  summary: string;
  praise: string;
  mistakes: {step: string; issue: string; fix: string}[];
  nextHint: string;
}

interface PhotoSolutionCheckerProps {
  taskStatement: string;
  taskLatex?: string;
  algorithmSummary?: string;
  expectedOutput?: string;
  /** Optional PNG/JPEG dataUrl injected directly from DrawingScratchpad */
  externalImageDataUrl?: string | null;
  onClearExternalImage?: () => void;
  onSolved?: () => void;
}

async function compressImageToDataUrl(file: File): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Не удалось прочитать файл'));
    reader.onload = () => {
      const src = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      const img = new Image();
      img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Не удалось декодировать изображение'));
      img.onload = () => {
        const maxSide = 1400;
        let {width, height} = img;
        if (width > maxSide || height > maxSide) {
          const ratio = Math.min(maxSide / width, maxSide / height);
          width = Math.round(width * ratio);
          height = Math.round(height * ratio);
        }
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = width;
        canvas.height = height;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) {
          resolve(src);
          return;
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
        resolve(canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.86));
      };
      img.src = src;
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

export function PhotoSolutionChecker({
  taskStatement,
  taskLatex,
  algorithmSummary,
  expectedOutput,
  externalImageDataUrl,
  onClearExternalImage,
  onSolved,
}: PhotoSolutionCheckerProps) {
  const [previewDataUrl, setPreviewDataUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<PhotoCheckResult | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const runCheck = async (dataUrl: string) => {
    setChecking(true);
    setError('');
    setResult(null);

    try {
      const match = dataUrl.match(/^data:(image\/[a-zA-Z0-9.+-]+);base64,(.+)$/);
      if (!match) {
        throw new Error('Некорректный формат изображения');
      }
      const mimeType = match[1];
      const imageBase64 = match[2];

      const res = await fetch('/api/exam/check-photo', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({
          imageBase64,
          mimeType,
          task: {
            problemStatement: taskStatement,
            problemLatex: taskLatex ?? '',
            algorithmSummary: algorithmSummary ?? '',
            expectedOutput: expectedOutput ?? '',
          },
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errBody = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(
          errBody.error || 'Не удалось проверить фото решения. Попробуйте ещё раз.',
        );
      }
      const data = (await res.json()) as PhotoCheckResult;
      setResult(data);
      if (data.verdict === 'correct' && onSolved) {
        onSolved();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Ошибка проверки фото');
    } finally {
      setChecking(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (externalImageDataUrl) {
      setPreviewDataUrl(externalImageDataUrl);
      void runCheck(externalImageDataUrl);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [externalImageDataUrl]);

  const handleFileChange = async (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      const compressed = await compressImageToDataUrl(file);
      setPreviewDataUrl(compressed);
      setResult(null);
      setError('');
      await runCheck(compressed);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка обработки фото');
    } finally {
      if (fileRef.current) fileRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#0B101B] p-3.5 space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Camera className="h-4 w-4 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400" />
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
            Проверка решения из тетради (или черновика) по фото
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <input
            ref={fileRef}
            type="file"
            accept="image/*"
            capture="environment"
            onChange={(e) => void handleFileChange(e)}
            className="hidden"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={checking}
            onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-md prism-cta disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Upload className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>
              {previewDataUrl ? 'Загрузить другое фото' : 'Загрузить фото тетради'}
            </span>
          </button>
          {previewDataUrl && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setPreviewDataUrl(null);
                setResult(null);
                setError('');
                onClearExternalImage?.();
              }}
              className="px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-[#94A3B8] dark:hover:text-[#F3F4F6] cursor-pointer"
            >
              Сбросить
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {previewDataUrl && (
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 items-start">
          <img
            src={previewDataUrl}
            alt="Фото вашего решения"
            className="w-full sm:w-44 max-h-44 object-contain rounded-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white shrink-0"
          />

          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-2.5">
            {checking && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400 py-3">
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                <span>
                  Преподаватель проверяет каждую строчку вашего решения...
                </span>
              </div>
            )}

            {error && (
              <div className="rounded-md border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800/70 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 p-2.5 text-xs text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200">
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            {result && (
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                <div
                  className={`rounded-md border p-3 text-xs space-y-1 ${
                    result.verdict === 'correct'
                      ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50/80 text-emerald-950 dark:border-emerald-800/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/35 dark:text-emerald-100'
                      : result.verdict === 'partial'
                        ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/80 text-amber-950 dark:border-amber-800/70 dark:bg-amber-950/35 dark:text-amber-100'
                        : 'border-rose-300 bg-rose-50/80 text-rose-950 dark:border-rose-800/70 dark:bg-rose-950/35 dark:text-rose-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold">
                    {result.verdict === 'correct' ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                    ) : result.verdict === 'partial' ? (
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                    ) : (
                      <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                    )}
                    <span>{result.verdictTitle}</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="leading-relaxed">{result.summary}</p>
                  {result.praise && (
                    <p className="text-[11px] opacity-90">
                      <Sparkles className="inline h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                      {result.praise}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {result.mistakes.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400">
                      Найденные неточности:
                    </p>
                    {result.mistakes.map((m, i) => (
                      <div
                        key={i}
                        className="rounded-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#0E1522] p-2.5 text-xs space-y-1"
                      >
                        <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                          Шаг: {m.step}
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400">
                          Ошибка: {m.issue}
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                          Как исправить: {m.fix}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {result.nextHint && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-sky-800 dark:text-sky-300 bg-sky-50/70 dark:bg-sky-950/25 border border-sky-200 dark:border-sky-800/50 rounded-md px-2.5 py-2">
                    Подсказка преподавателя: {result.nextHint}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {useEffect, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import {Coffee, Pause, Play, RotateCcw, Timer} from 'lucide-react';

interface PomodoroTimerProps {
  focusMinutes: number;
  breakMinutes: number;
  onChangeDurations: (focusMinutes: number, breakMinutes: number) => void;
  onFocusMinuteCompleted: () => void;
  sessionReviewsCount: number;
  remainingCardsToMaster: number;
  totalFocusMinutesToday: number;
}

const FOCUS_PRESETS: ReadonlyArray<{focus: number; brk: number}> = [
  {focus: 25, brk: 5},
  {focus: 45, brk: 10},
  {focus: 50, brk: 10},
  {focus: 90, brk: 15},
];

export function PomodoroTimer({
  focusMinutes,
  breakMinutes,
  onChangeDurations,
  onFocusMinuteCompleted,
  sessionReviewsCount,
  remainingCardsToMaster,
  totalFocusMinutesToday,
}: PomodoroTimerProps) {
  const safeFocusMin = Math.max(5, Math.min(120, Math.round(focusMinutes)));
  const safeBreakMin = Math.max(1, Math.min(45, Math.round(breakMinutes)));
  const focusSeconds = safeFocusMin * 60;
  const breakSeconds = safeBreakMin * 60;

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'focus' | 'break'>('focus');
  const [secondsLeft, setSecondsLeft] = useState<number>(focusSeconds);
  const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [elapsedFocusSecThisSession, setElapsedFocusSecThisSession] =
    useState<number>(0);

  const minuteAccumulatorRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const onFocusMinuteRef = useRef(onFocusMinuteCompleted);
  onFocusMinuteRef.current = onFocusMinuteCompleted;

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsRunning(false);
    setPhase('focus');
    setSecondsLeft(safeFocusMin * 60);
    minuteAccumulatorRef.current = 0;
  }, [safeFocusMin, safeBreakMin]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isRunning) return;
    const id = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (phase === 'focus') {
        setElapsedFocusSecThisSession((s) => s + 1);
        minuteAccumulatorRef.current += 1;
        if (minuteAccumulatorRef.current >= 60) {
          minuteAccumulatorRef.current = 0;
          onFocusMinuteRef.current();
        }
      }
      setSecondsLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          const nextPhase = phase === 'focus' ? 'break' : 'focus';
          setPhase(nextPhase);
          setIsRunning(false);
          return nextPhase === 'focus' ? focusSeconds : breakSeconds;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [isRunning, phase, focusSeconds, breakSeconds]);

  const mins = Math.floor(secondsLeft / 60);
  const secs = secondsLeft % 60;
  const formattedTime = `${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  const effectiveFocusMins = Math.max(
    1,
    elapsedFocusSecThisSession / 60 +
      (sessionReviewsCount > 0 ? 0 : totalFocusMinutesToday),
  );
  const hasRealPace =
    sessionReviewsCount >= 2 && elapsedFocusSecThisSession >= 30;
  const cardsPerPomodoro = hasRealPace
    ? Math.max(
        1,
        Math.round((sessionReviewsCount / effectiveFocusMins) * safeFocusMin),
      )
    : 12;
  const estHoursToMaster =
    remainingCardsToMaster <= 0
      ? 0
      : Math.max(
          0.5,
          Math.round(
            (remainingCardsToMaster / cardsPerPomodoro) * (safeFocusMin / 60) * 2,
          ) / 2,
        );

  const handleReset = () => {
    setIsRunning(false);
    setSecondsLeft(phase === 'focus' ? focusSeconds : breakSeconds);
  };

  const handleTogglePhase = () => {
    setIsRunning(false);
    const nextPhase = phase === 'focus' ? 'break' : 'focus';
    setPhase(nextPhase);
    setSecondsLeft(nextPhase === 'focus' ? focusSeconds : breakSeconds);
  };

  const handleCycleMode = () => {
    const idx = FOCUS_PRESETS.findIndex(
      (p) => p.focus === safeFocusMin && p.brk === safeBreakMin,
    );
    const next = FOCUS_PRESETS[(idx + 1) % FOCUS_PRESETS.length];
    onChangeDurations(next.focus, next.brk);
  };

  const paceTooltip =
    remainingCardsToMaster <= 0
      ? `Фокус сегодня: ${totalFocusMinutesToday} мин · Все карточки выучены`
      : `Фокус сегодня: ${totalFocusMinutesToday} мин · Темп: ~${cardsPerPomodoro} карт./${safeFocusMin} мин · Прогноз до 100%: ~${estHoursToMaster} ч`;

  return (
    <div
      title={paceTooltip}
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-full transition-all shrink-0 ${
        isRunning
          ? 'prism-tab-active'
          : 'border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.1] bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-[#0E1522]/95'
      }`}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleTogglePhase}
        title={phase === 'focus' ? 'Переключить на перерыв' : 'Переключить на фокус'}
        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-[#9CA3AF] hover:text-slate-950 dark:hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
      >
        {phase === 'focus' ? (
          <Timer className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" />
        ) : (
          <Coffee className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
        )}
        <span className="hidden sm:inline">
          {phase === 'focus' ? 'Фокус' : 'Отдых'}
        </span>
      </button>

      <span className="font-mono text-xs sm:text-[13px] font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-950 dark:text-[#F8FAFC] px-1">
        {formattedTime}
      </span>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsRunning((r) => !r)}
        aria-label={isRunning ? 'Пауза' : 'Старт фокус-таймера'}
        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
          isRunning
            ? 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/35 hover:bg-amber-500/25'
            : 'prism-tool-btn text-slate-800 dark:text-[#F1F5F9]'
        }`}
      >
        {isRunning ? (
          <>
            <Pause className="h-3 w-3" />
            <span>Пауза</span>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Play className="h-3 w-3" />
            <span>Старт</span>
          </>
        )}
      </button>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleReset}
        title="Сбросить таймер"
        aria-label="Сбросить таймер"
        className="p-1 rounded-full text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-[#9CA3AF] dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-200/70 dark:hover:bg-white/[0.08] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
      >
        <RotateCcw className="h-3 w-3" />
      </button>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleCycleMode}
        title="Переключить пресет фокуса (25/5, 45/10, 50/10, 90/15) или задайте вручную в Настройках"
        className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono tabular-nums font-medium rounded-full bg-white/80 dark:bg-white/[0.06] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#CBD5E1] hover:text-slate-950 dark:hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
      >
        {safeFocusMin}/{safeBreakMin}
      </button>

      <span className="hidden xl:inline-flex items-center pl-1 pr-1 text-[11px] font-mono tabular-nums text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF] border-l border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.08]">
        {totalFocusMinutesToday}м
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useState} from 'react';
import {
  Award,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Coffee,
  Film,
  Gamepad2,
  Lock,
  Pizza,
  Plus,
  Sparkles,
  Trash2,
  Trophy,
  Unlock,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {RewardItem, RewardSystemState} from '../types/study';
import {DEFAULT_REWARDS} from '../utils/rewards';

interface RewardsModalProps {
  rewardState: RewardSystemState;
  onClaimReward: (reward: RewardItem) => void;
  onEndActiveBreak: () => void;
  onAddCustomReward: (reward: RewardItem) => void;
  onDeleteReward: (rewardId: string) => void;
  onRestoreDefaults: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

function RewardIcon({
  kind,
  className = 'h-5 w-5',
}: {
  kind: RewardItem['icon'];
  className?: string;
}) {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'dota':
      return <Gamepad2 className={className} />;
    case 'coffee':
      return <Coffee className={className} />;
    case 'movie':
      return <Film className={className} />;
    case 'food':
      return <Pizza className={className} />;
    case 'party':
      return <Trophy className={className} />;
    default:
      return <Sparkles className={className} />;
  }
}

function formatCountdown(ms: number): string {
  const totalSec = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000));
  const h = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((totalSec % 3600) / 60);
  const s = totalSec % 60;
  if (h > 0) {
    return `${h}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
  return `${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

  rewardState,
  onClaimReward,
  onEndActiveBreak,
  onAddCustomReward,
  onDeleteReward,
  onRestoreDefaults,
  onClose,

  const [nowMs, setNowMs] = useState(() => Date.now());

    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);

                            canAfford
                              ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                              : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#131B2B] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {reward.costXp} XP
                        </span>
                        {reward.isCustom && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onDeleteReward(reward.id)}
                            title="Удалить свою награду"
                            className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Progress or Claim Button */}
                    {canAfford ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onClaimReward(reward)}
                        className="w-full inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-500 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <Unlock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        <span>
                          {redeemedToday
                            ? 'Забрать допуск ещё раз'
                            : 'Разрешено! Забрать допуск и идти отдыхать'}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="space-y-1.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Lock className="h-3 w-3" />
                            Ещё не открыто
                          </span>
                          <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">
                            {rewardState.balanceXp}/{reward.costXp} XP
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="h-1.5 w-full rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#131B2B] overflow-hidden">
                          <div
                            className="h-full bg-sky-500/80 transition-all duration-300"
                            style={{width: `${pct}%`}}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {useEffect} from 'react';
import {
  Clock,
  Download,
  Flame,
  Moon,
  PartyPopper,
  RotateCcw,
  Save,
  Settings,
  Snowflake,
  Sparkles,
  Sun,
  Target,
  Upload,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {AppPreferences, StudyPlannerSettings} from '../types/study';

interface SettingsModalProps {
  preferences: AppPreferences;
  plannerSettings: StudyPlannerSettings;
  theme: 'dark' | 'light';
  onUpdatePreferences: (patch: Partial<AppPreferences>) => void;
  onResetPreferences: () => void;
  onUpdatePlanner: (patch: Partial<StudyPlannerSettings>) => void;
  onChangeTheme: (theme: 'dark' | 'light') => void;
  onExportNow: () => void;
  onImportClick: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const FOCUS_PRESETS: ReadonlyArray<{
  label: string;
  focus: number;
  brk: number;
}> = [
  {label: '25 / 5', focus: 25, brk: 5},
  {label: '45 / 10', focus: 45, brk: 10},
  {label: '50 / 10', focus: 50, brk: 10},
  {label: '90 / 15', focus: 90, brk: 15},
];

const AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL_PRESETS = [5, 15, 30, 60] as const;

function ToggleRow({
  icon,
  title,
  description,
  checked,
  onToggle,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  checked: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 py-2.5">
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0">
        <div className="mt-0.5 w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#121926] border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.1] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
          {icon}
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="text-xs sm:text-[13px] font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
            {title}
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8] leading-snug mt-0.5">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        role="switch"
        aria-checked={checked}
        onClick={onToggle}
        className={`relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full border transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
          checked
            ? 'bg-emerald-500/85 border-emerald-400/70'
            : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#121926] border-slate-300 dark:border-white/[0.15]'
        }`}
      >
        <span
          className={`inline-block h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm transition-transform ${
            checked ? 'translate-x-5.5' : 'translate-x-1'
          }`}
        />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function formatSavedTime(ts?: number): string {
  if (!ts) return 'ещё не выполнялось';
  try {
    return new Date(ts).toLocaleTimeString('ru-RU', {
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      second: '2-digit',
    });
  } catch {
    return 'недавно';
  }
}

export function SettingsModal({
  preferences,
  plannerSettings,
  theme,
  onUpdatePreferences,
  onResetPreferences,
  onUpdatePlanner,
  onChangeTheme,
  onExportNow,
  onImportClick,
  onClose,
}: SettingsModalProps) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [onClose]);

  const handleFocusInput = (val: string) => {
    const n = Number(val);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return;
    const clamped = Math.max(5, Math.min(120, Math.round(n)));
    onUpdatePreferences({focusMinutes: clamped});
  };

  const handleBreakInput = (val: string) => {
    const n = Number(val);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return;
    const clamped = Math.max(1, Math.min(45, Math.round(n)));
    onUpdatePreferences({breakMinutes: clamped});
  };

  const handleDailyGoalInput = (val: string) => {
    const n = Number(val);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return;
    const clamped = Math.max(5, Math.min(100, Math.round(n)));
    onUpdatePlanner({dailyGoal: clamped});
  };

  const handleAutoSaveIntervalInput = (val: string) => {
    const n = Number(val);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return;
    const clamped = Math.max(1, Math.min(240, Math.round(n)));
    onUpdatePreferences({autoSaveIntervalMinutes: clamped});

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-xs p-4"

          <button

          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" />

        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Content */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 py-5 space-y-6">
          {/* Section 1: Atmosphere & UI */}
          <section className="space-y-1">

          <button

          >
            <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Сбросить настройки по умолчанию</span>

          <button

          >
            Готово
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
```

## FILE: src/components/SlideAttachmentsPanel.tsx

```tsx
import {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Maximize2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {LECTURE_MAP} from '../data/lectures';
import {SlideAttachment} from '../types/study';
import {SlideCanvas} from './SlideCanvas';
import {SlideModal} from './SlideModal';

interface SlideAttachmentsPanelProps {
  slides: SlideAttachment[];
  heading?: string;
  compact?: boolean;
  defaultHidden?: boolean;
}

export function SlideAttachmentsPanel({
  slides,
  heading = 'Прикреплённые слайды лекции',
  compact = false,
  defaultHidden = true,
}: SlideAttachmentsPanelProps) {
  const [selectedIdx, setSelectedIdx] = useState(0);
  const [browseOffset, setBrowseOffset] = useState(0);
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isHidden, setIsHidden] = useState(defaultHidden);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedIdx(0);
    setBrowseOffset(0);
    setIsHidden(defaultHidden);
  }, [slides, defaultHidden]);

  if (slides.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const activeAttachment = slides[selectedIdx] ?? slides[0];
  const lecture = LECTURE_MAP[activeAttachment.lectureId];
  const currentPage = Math.max(
    1,
    Math.min(activeAttachment.page + browseOffset, lecture.pageCount),
  );

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
            <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
              {heading}
            </h4>
            {activeAttachment.isAnswerSlide && browseOffset === 0 && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                <span>Слайд с ответом</span>
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsHidden((h) => !h)}
            className="prism-tool-btn inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-full text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E5E7EB] whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {isHidden ? (
              <>
                <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" />
                <span>Показать слайд</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
```

```tsx
import {useEffect, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import * as pdfjsLib from 'pdfjs-dist';
import pdfWorkerUrl from 'pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url';
import {LECTURE_MAP} from '../data/lectures';
import {LectureId} from '../types/study';
import {FileWarning, Loader2} from 'lucide-react';

pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = pdfWorkerUrl;

const docCache = new Map<string, Promise<pdfjsLib.PDFDocumentProxy>>();

function loadPdfDocument(url: string): Promise<pdfjsLib.PDFDocumentProxy> {
  const existing = docCache.get(url);
  if (existing) {
    return existing;
  }
  const loadingTask = pdfjsLib.getDocument({url});
  const promise = loadingTask.promise.catch((err) => {
    docCache.delete(url);
    throw err;
  });
  docCache.set(url, promise);
  return promise;
}

interface SlideCanvasProps {
  lectureId: LectureId;
  page: number;
  /** Target display width in CSS pixels; canvas automatically adapts to container width */
  maxWidth?: number;
  className?: string;
}

export function SlideCanvas({
  lectureId,
  page,
  maxWidth = 880,
  className = '',
}: SlideCanvasProps) {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const [containerWidth, setContainerWidth] = useState<number>(maxWidth);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'>('loading');
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string>('');

  const lecture = LECTURE_MAP[lectureId];
  const safePage = Math.max(1, Math.min(page, lecture.pageCount));

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = containerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;

    const updateWidth = () => {
      const w = el.clientWidth;
      if (w > 0) {
        setContainerWidth(Math.min(w, maxWidth));
      }
    };

    updateWidth();
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(updateWidth);
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [maxWidth]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    let activeRenderTask: pdfjsLib.RenderTask | null = null;

    async function renderSlide() {
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      if (!canvas) return;
      setStatus('loading');
      setErrorMessage('');

      try {
        const doc = await loadPdfDocument(lecture.url);
        if (cancelled) return;

        const pdfPage = await doc.getPage(safePage);
        if (cancelled) return;

        const baseViewport = pdfPage.getViewport({scale: 1});
        const targetCssWidth = Math.max(240, containerWidth);
        const scale = targetCssWidth / baseViewport.width;
        const viewport = pdfPage.getViewport({scale});

        const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height * dpr);
        canvas.style.width = `${Math.floor(viewport.width)}px`;
        canvas.style.height = `${Math.floor(viewport.height)}px`;

        const renderParams: Parameters<typeof pdfPage.render>[0] = {
          canvas,
          viewport,
          transform: dpr !== 1 ? [dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0] : undefined,
        };

        activeRenderTask = pdfPage.render(renderParams);
        await activeRenderTask.promise;

        if (!cancelled) {
          setStatus('ready');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
        if (msg.toLowerCase().includes('cancel')) {
          return;
        }
        setErrorMessage('Не удалось загрузить слайд лекции');
        setStatus('error');
      }
    }

    renderSlide();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      if (activeRenderTask) {
        activeRenderTask.cancel();
      }
    };
  }, [lecture.url, safePage, containerWidth]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={`relative w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.12] bg-white dark:bg-[#0B111C] flex items-center justify-center min-h-[300px] ${className}`}
    >
      {status === 'loading' && (
        <div
          className="absolute inset-0 z-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-slate-100/75 dark:bg-[#0B111C]/75 backdrop-blur-[2px] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E2E8F0]"
          aria-live="polite"
        >
          <Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" />
          <span className="text-xs font-medium tabular-nums">
            Загрузка слайда {safePage} ({lecture.shortTitle})...
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {status === 'error' ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 p-8 text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          <FileWarning className="h-6 w-6 text-rose-500" />
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
            {errorMessage}
          </p>
          <p className="text-xs tabular-nums">
            {lecture.shortTitle} · стр. {safePage}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <canvas
          ref={canvasRef}
          className="block w-full max-w-full h-auto"
          aria-label={`${lecture.shortTitle}, страница ${safePage}`}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
import {ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X, ZoomIn, ZoomOut} from 'lucide-react';
import {LECTURE_MAP} from '../data/lectures';
import {LectureId} from '../types/study';
import {SlideCanvas} from './SlideCanvas';

interface SlideModalProps {
  lectureId: LectureId;
  initialPage: number;
  title?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function SlideModal({
  lectureId,
  initialPage,
  title,
  onClose,
}: SlideModalProps) {
  const lecture = LECTURE_MAP[lectureId];
  const [page, setPage] = useState(initialPage);
  const [zoomWidth, setZoomWidth] = useState(980);

  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(initialPage);
  }, [initialPage, lectureId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        onClose();
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1));
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        setPage((p) => Math.min(lecture.pageCount, p + 1));
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
  }, [lecture.pageCount, onClose]);

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#04070D]/80 backdrop-blur-md p-4 sm:p-6"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label={title ?? lecture.title}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className="flex flex-col w-full max-w-6xl max-h-[92vh] rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-[#0F172A] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 truncate">
              {title ?? lecture.title}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 tabular-nums">
              {lecture.shortTitle} · {lecture.chapterLabel} · страница {page} из {lecture.pageCount}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            <div className="flex items-center border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setZoomWidth((w) => Math.max(680, w - 160))}
                className="p-2 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Уменьшить масштаб"
              >
                <ZoomOut className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
              <span className="px-2.5 text-xs font-mono tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 whitespace-nowrap">
                {Math.round((zoomWidth / 980) * 100)}%
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setZoomWidth((w) => Math.min(1460, w + 160))}
                className="p-2 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Увеличить масштаб"
              >
                <ZoomIn className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={page <= 1}
                onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                className="p-2 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-40 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                aria-label="Предыдущая страница"
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
              <span className="px-2.5 text-xs font-mono tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 whitespace-nowrap">
                {page} / {lecture.pageCount}
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={page >= lecture.pageCount}
                onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(lecture.pageCount, p + 1))}
                className="p-2 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-40 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                aria-label="Следующая страница"
              >
                <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Закрыть просмотр"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto p-4 sm:p-6 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#0B1120] flex justify-center">
          <div style={{width: `${zoomWidth}px`, maxWidth: '100%'}}>
            <SlideCanvas lectureId={lectureId} page={page} maxWidth={zoomWidth} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowRight,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Flame,
  Loader2,
  RotateCcw,
  ShieldAlert,
  Sparkles,
  Trophy,
  X,
  XCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  getCuratedRoundsForCategory,
  SpotTheLieRound,
} from '../data/spotTheLieData';
import {StudyCategory, TheoryCard} from '../types/study';
import {MathBlock} from './MathBlock';

interface SpotTheLieModalProps {
  category: StudyCategory;
  subjectTitle: string;
  allCards: TheoryCard[];
  onOpenCardInDeck?: (cardId: number) => void;
  onCorrectRound?: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const ROUND_SECONDS = 30;
const SESSION_TARGET = 10;

function shuffle<T>(arr: T[]): T[] {
  const copy = [...arr];
  for (let i = copy.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [copy[i], copy[j]] = [copy[j], copy[i]];
  }
  return copy;
}

export function SpotTheLieModal({
  category,
  subjectTitle,
  allCards,
  onOpenCardInDeck,
  onCorrectRound,
  onClose,
}: SpotTheLieModalProps) {
  const initialPool = useMemo(
    () => shuffle(getCuratedRoundsForCategory(category)),
    [category],
  );

  const [rounds, setRounds] = useState<SpotTheLieRound[]>(initialPool);
  const [roundIdx, setRoundIdx] = useState(0);
  const [timeLeftMs, setTimeLeftMs] = useState(ROUND_SECONDS * 1000);
  const [selectedStepIdx, setSelectedStepIdx] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [timedOut, setTimedOut] = useState(false);

  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [played, setPlayed] = useState(0);
  const [streak, setStreak] = useState(0);
  const [bestStreak, setBestStreak] = useState(0);
  const [reactionTimesSec, setReactionTimesSec] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [sessionDone, setSessionDone] = useState(false);

  const [isGeneratingAi, setIsGeneratingAi] = useState(false);
  const [aiError, setAiError] = useState('');

  const timerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const currentRound = rounds[roundIdx] ?? null;
  const isResolved = selectedStepIdx !== null || timedOut;

  // Countdown timer
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentRound || isResolved || sessionDone || isGeneratingAi) {
      if (timerRef.current !== null) {
        window.clearInterval(timerRef.current);
        timerRef.current = null;
      }
      return;
    }

    const startedAt = Date.now();
    const initialRemaining = timeLeftMs;

    timerRef.current = window.setInterval(() => {
      const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAt;
      const next = Math.max(0, initialRemaining - elapsed);
      setTimeLeftMs(next);
      if (next <= 0) {
        if (timerRef.current !== null) {
          window.clearInterval(timerRef.current);
          timerRef.current = null;
        }
        setTimedOut(true);
        setPlayed((p) => p + 1);
        setStreak(0);
      }
    }, 100);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current !== null) {
        window.clearInterval(timerRef.current);
        timerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [roundIdx, isResolved, sessionDone, isGeneratingAi, currentRound?.id]);

  // Escape key closes modal
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  const handleSelectStep = (idx: number) => {
    if (!currentRound || isResolved) return;
    const elapsedSec = Math.max(
      0.4,
      Number(((ROUND_SECONDS * 1000 - timeLeftMs) / 1000).toFixed(1)),
    );
    setSelectedStepIdx(idx);
    setPlayed((p) => p + 1);

    if (idx === currentRound.poisonedIndex) {
      setScore((s) => s + 1);
      onCorrectRound?.();
      setReactionTimesSec((prev) => [...prev, elapsedSec]);
      setStreak((prev) => {
        const next = prev + 1;
        setBestStreak((b) => Math.max(b, next));
        return next;
      });
    } else {
      setStreak(0);
    }
  };

  const generateAiRound = useCallback(async () => {
    if (allCards.length === 0) return;
    setIsGeneratingAi(true);
    setAiError('');
    try {
      // Prefer cards with rich proofs / points
      const candidates = allCards.filter((c) => c.answerPoints.length >= 3);
      const pool = candidates.length > 0 ? candidates : allCards;
      const picked = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];

      const res = await fetch('/api/exam/spot-the-lie', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({
          card: {
            id: picked.id,
            question: picked.question,
            keyThesis: picked.keyThesis,
            answerPoints: picked.answerPoints,
            examTip: picked.examTip,
          },
          subjectTitle,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(body.error || 'Не удалось сгенерировать новый раунд');
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      const newRound: SpotTheLieRound = {
        id: `ai-lie-${Date.now()}`,
        category: 'custom',
        title: data.title,
        statement: data.statement,
        steps: data.steps,
        poisonedIndex: data.poisonedIndex,
        fallacyType: data.fallacyType,
        explanation: data.explanation,
        correctStep: data.correctStep,
        linkedCardId: picked.id,
      };
      setRounds((prev) => {
        const next = [...prev, newRound];
        setRoundIdx(next.length - 1);
        return next;
      });
      setSelectedStepIdx(null);
      setTimedOut(false);
      setTimeLeftMs(ROUND_SECONDS * 1000);
    } catch (err) {
      setAiError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка генерации ИИ-раунда',
      );
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingAi(false);
    }
  }, [allCards, subjectTitle]);

  const handleNextRound = () => {
    if (played >= SESSION_TARGET) {
      setSessionDone(true);
      return;
    }
    if (roundIdx + 1 < rounds.length) {
      setRoundIdx((i) => i + 1);
      setSelectedStepIdx(null);
      setTimedOut(false);
      setTimeLeftMs(ROUND_SECONDS * 1000);
    } else {
      // Out of curated rounds -> auto-generate fresh AI proof from current deck!
      void generateAiRound();
    }
  };

  const handleRestartSession = () => {
    setRounds(shuffle(getCuratedRoundsForCategory(category)));
    setRoundIdx(0);
    setSelectedStepIdx(null);
    setTimedOut(false);
    setTimeLeftMs(ROUND_SECONDS * 1000);
    setScore(0);
    setPlayed(0);
    setStreak(0);
    setBestStreak(0);
    setReactionTimesSec([]);
    setSessionDone(false);
    setAiError('');
  };

  const secDisplay = (timeLeftMs / 1000).toFixed(1);
  const progressPct = Math.max(
    0,
    Math.min(100, (timeLeftMs / (ROUND_SECONDS * 1000)) * 100),
  );
  const timerColor =
    timeLeftMs <= 7500
      ? 'bg-rose-500 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(244,63,94,0.6)]'
      : timeLeftMs <= 15000
        ? 'bg-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,158,11,0.5)]'
        : 'prism-progress-fill';

  const avgReaction =
    reactionTimesSec.length > 0
      ? (
          reactionTimesSec.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / reactionTimesSec.length
        ).toFixed(1)
      : '—';

  const wasCorrect =
    currentRound !== null && selectedStepIdx === currentRound.poisonedIndex;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Игра Найди ложь за 30 секунд"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#04070D]/80 backdrop-blur-md p-3 sm:p-5 overflow-y-auto"
    >
      <div className="w-full max-w-3xl prism-surface rounded-[20px] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden my-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200/75 dark:border-white/[0.07] flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
            <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-2xl bg-rose-500/14 border border-rose-500/25 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-[#F8FAFC] truncate">
                Найди ложь за 30 секунд
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF] truncate">
                {subjectTitle} · Ткни в единственную «отравленную» строку доказательства
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
            <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-[#131B2B] border border-slate-200/75 dark:border-white/[0.07] text-xs font-mono tabular-nums">
              <span className="text-slate-600 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">
                Раунд <strong className="text-slate-950 dark:text-white">{Math.min(played + (isResolved ? 0 : 1), SESSION_TARGET)}/{SESSION_TARGET}</strong>
              </span>
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-slate-300 dark:text-white/15">·</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
                {score} верно
              </span>
              {streak >= 2 && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold">
                  <Flame className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  {streak}×
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Закрыть"
              className="prism-tool-btn p-2 rounded-full text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF] hover:text-slate-950 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Body */}
        <div className="p-6 sm:p-7 max-h-[82vh] overflow-y-auto space-y-5">
          {sessionDone ? (
            <div className="py-6 text-center space-y-5">
              <div className="mx-auto h-14 w-14 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/15 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-500 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Trophy className="h-7 w-7" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-white">
                  Серия из {played} раундов завершена!
                </h3>
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-[#9CA3AF] max-w-lg mx-auto">
                  {score >= 8
                    ? 'Уровень «Детектор лжи»: на экзамене тебя невозможно подловить на подмене кванторов или скрытом делении на ноль.'
                    : score >= 5
                      ? 'Хорошая хватка! Повтори ещё серию — и логические дыры будут бросаться в глаза мгновенно.'
                      : 'Отличная разминка для внимания — теперь ты точно знаешь главные ловушки экзаменаторов.'}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 max-w-md mx-auto">
                <div className="prism-subpanel rounded-2xl p-3.5">
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">Точность</div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-xl font-bold font-mono tabular-nums text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                    {score}/{played}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="prism-subpanel rounded-2xl p-3.5">
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">Макс. комбо</div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-xl font-bold font-mono tabular-nums text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
                    {bestStreak}×
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="prism-subpanel rounded-2xl p-3.5">
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">Ср. скорость</div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-xl font-bold font-mono tabular-nums text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400">
                    {avgReaction}с
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2.5 pt-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleRestartSession}
                  className="prism-cta inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold rounded-full cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>Новая серия (10 раундов)</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={onClose}
                  className="prism-tool-btn px-5 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium rounded-full text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E5E7EB] cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Вернуться к подготовке
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : isGeneratingAi ? (
            <div className="py-16 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 text-center">
              <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-cyan-400" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
                Прячем тонкую математическую ловушку в новом доказательстве...
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">
                Собираем 6 правдоподобных шагов по билетам «{subjectTitle}»
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : currentRound ? (
            <>
              {/* Timer Bar */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs font-mono tabular-nums">
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E5E7EB]">
                    <Clock className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${timeLeftMs <= 7500 && !isResolved ? 'text-rose-500 animate-pulse' : 'text-cyan-400'}`} />
                    {isResolved
                      ? timedOut
                        ? 'Время вышло!'
                        : `Ответ дан за ${Math.max(0.4, Number(((ROUND_SECONDS * 1000 - timeLeftMs) / 1000).toFixed(1)))} сек`
                      : `Осталось: ${secDisplay} сек`}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => void generateAiRound()}
                    className="prism-tool-btn inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-sans font-medium rounded-full text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                    <span>Сгенерировать ИИ-ловушку по колоде</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="h-2 w-full rounded-full bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-white/[0.06] overflow-hidden">
                  <div
                    className={`h-full transition-all duration-100 ${timerColor}`}
                    style={{width: `${progressPct}%`}}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {aiError && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-rose-500/35 bg-rose-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200">
                  {aiError}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Proof Statement Header */}
              <div className="prism-subpanel rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5">
                <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-400/90">
                  Доказательство / вывод
                </div>
                <h3 className="mt-1 text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
                  {currentRound.title}
                </h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-[#CBD5E1]">
                  {currentRound.statement}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* 6 Clickable Steps */}
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                {currentRound.steps.map((step, idx) => {
                  const isPoisoned = idx === currentRound.poisonedIndex;
                  const isPicked = idx === selectedStepIdx;

                  let cardStyle =
                    'border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.07] bg-white/85 dark:bg-[#131B2B]/85 hover:border-cyan-400/55 dark:hover:border-cyan-400/55 hover:bg-cyan-50/50 dark:hover:bg-[#172336] hover:shadow-[0_0_18px_-8px_rgba(34,211,238,0.45)] cursor-pointer';
                  if (isResolved) {
                    if (isPoisoned && isPicked) {
                      cardStyle =
                        'border-emerald-400/70 bg-emerald-500/14 shadow-[0_0_20px_-6px_rgba(52,211,153,0.45)]';
                    } else if (isPoisoned) {
                      cardStyle =
                        'border-rose-500/70 bg-rose-500/14 shadow-[0_0_20px_-6px_rgba(244,63,94,0.45)]';
                    } else if (isPicked) {
                      cardStyle =
                        'border-amber-400/70 bg-amber-500/14';
                    } else {
                      cardStyle =
                        'border-slate-200/60 dark:border-white/[0.05] bg-white/50 dark:bg-[#0B101B]/65 opacity-60';
                    }
                  }

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={`${currentRound.id}-step-${idx}`}
                      type="button"
                      disabled={isResolved}
                      onClick={() => handleSelectStep(idx)}
                      className={`w-full text-left rounded-2xl border p-3.5 sm:p-4 transition-all flex items-start gap-3 ${cardStyle}`}
                    >
                      <span
                        className={`mt-0.5 h-6 w-6 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono tabular-nums font-bold flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                          isResolved && isPoisoned
                            ? wasCorrect
                              ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950'
                              : 'bg-rose-500 text-white'
                            : isResolved && isPicked
                              ? 'bg-amber-400 text-slate-950'
                              : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#0E1522] border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#CBD5E1]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {idx + 1}
                      </span>
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1.5">
                        <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                          {step.text}
                        </p>
                        {step.latex && (
                          <div className="overflow-x-auto pt-0.5">
                            <MathBlock latex={step.latex} displayMode={false} />
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {isResolved && isPoisoned && (
                        <span className="shrink-0 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500/20 border border-rose-400/40 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300">
                          Ложь
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Verdict & Forensic Explanation */}
              {isResolved && (
                <div
                  className={`rounded-2xl border p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-3 ${
                    wasCorrect
                      ? 'border-emerald-400/35 bg-emerald-500/10'
                      : 'border-rose-400/35 bg-rose-500/10'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      {wasCorrect ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-500 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                      ) : timedOut ? (
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400" />
                      ) : (
                        <XCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400" />
                      )}
                      <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
                        {wasCorrect
                          ? `Поймал ложь! Шаг №${currentRound.poisonedIndex + 1} разоблачён`
                          : timedOut
                            ? `Не успел — ложь скрывалась в шаге №${currentRound.poisonedIndex + 1}`
                            : `Промах! Отравлен был шаг №${currentRound.poisonedIndex + 1}`}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-900/10 dark:bg-white/[0.08] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
                      Ловушка: {currentRound.fallacyType}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-800 dark:text-[#E5E7EB]">
                    {currentRound.explanation}
                  </p>

                  <div className="prism-subpanel rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-[#E5E7EB]">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                      Как правильно:{' '}
                    </span>
                    {currentRound.correctStep}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1">
                    {currentRound.linkedCardId && onOpenCardInDeck ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          onOpenCardInDeck(currentRound.linkedCardId!);
                          onClose();
                        }}
                        className="text-xs font-medium text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-400 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Открыть связанный билет №{currentRound.linkedCardId} в колоде →
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <span />
                    )}

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleNextRound}
                      className="prism-cta inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <span>
                        {played >= SESSION_TARGET
                          ? 'Показать итоги серии'
                          : 'Следующий раунд'}
                      </span>
                      <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {useMemo} from 'react';
import {
  CardSRState,
  DailyActivityMap,
  QuestionChapter,
  StudyCategory,
  StudyPlannerSettings,
  TaskCard,
  TaskMasteryStatus,
  TheoryCard,
} from '../types/study';
import {
  addDaysToDateKey,
  computeActivityStreaks,
  getLocalDateKey,
} from '../utils/cardHelpers';
import {getCardSRState} from '../utils/spacedRepetition';

interface StudyAnalyticsPanelProps {
  category: StudyCategory;
  subjectLabel?: string;
  allCards: TheoryCard[];
  tasks: TaskCard[];
  srMap: Record<number, CardSRState>;
  taskMastery: Record<string, TaskMasteryStatus>;
  activityLog: DailyActivityMap;
  plannerSettings: StudyPlannerSettings;
  onUpdatePlanner: (patch: Partial<StudyPlannerSettings>) => void;
  onUpdateExamDate: (category: StudyCategory, dateIso: string) => void;
  onJumpToChapter: (chapter: QuestionChapter) => void;
}

export function StudyAnalyticsPanel({
  category,
  subjectLabel,
  allCards,
  tasks,
  srMap,
  taskMastery,
  activityLog,
  plannerSettings,
  onUpdatePlanner,
  onUpdateExamDate,
  onJumpToChapter,
}: StudyAnalyticsPanelProps) {
  const now = Date.now();
  const examDateIso =
    plannerSettings.examDates[category] ?? addDaysToDateKey(14);
  const displayTargetName =
    category === 'rk'
      ? 'РК 2'
      : category === 'matan'
        ? 'экзамена Матан'
        : category === 'exam'
          ? 'экзамена АИП'
          : subjectLabel || 'экзамена';

  const {todayTotal, bestStreak} = useMemo(
    () => computeActivityStreaks(activityLog, plannerSettings.dailyGoal),
    [activityLog, plannerSettings.dailyGoal],
  );

  const planMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    const todayMidnight = new Date(`${getLocalDateKey()}T00:00:00`).getTime();
    const targetMidnight = new Date(`${examDateIso}T00:00:00`).getTime();
    const rawDays = Math.ceil((targetMidnight - todayMidnight) / 86400000);
    const daysLeft = Math.max(1, Number.isFinite(rawDays) ? rawDays : 7);

    let unseenCards = 0;
    let dueReviews = 0;

    for (const c of allCards) {
      const sr = getCardSRState(srMap, c.id);
      if (sr.status === 'unseen') unseenCards++;
      const isOverdue =
        sr.nextReviewAt !== undefined && sr.nextReviewAt <= now;
      if (sr.status === 'hard' || isOverdue) dueReviews++;
    }

    const unsolvedTasks = tasks.filter(
      (t) => (taskMastery[t.id] ?? 'unsolved') !== 'solved',
    ).length;

    const dailyNewCards =
      unseenCards > 0 ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(unseenCards / daysLeft)) : 0;
    const dailyTasks =
      unsolvedTasks > 0 ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(unsolvedTasks / daysLeft)) : 0;

    return {
      daysLeft,
      dailyNewCards,
      dueReviews,
      dailyTasks,
    };
  }, [examDateIso, allCards, srMap, tasks, taskMastery, now]);

  const heatmapDays = useMemo(() => {
    const list: {
      key: string;
      label: string;
      total: number;
      reviews: number;
      tasksSolved: number;
      focusMinutes: number;
      level: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;
    }[] = [];

    const goal = Math.max(5, plannerSettings.dailyGoal);
    const today = new Date();
    for (let offset = 27; offset >= 0; offset--) {
      const d = new Date(today);
      d.setDate(today.getDate() - offset);
      const key = getLocalDateKey(d);
      const entry = activityLog[key];
      const reviews = entry?.reviews ?? 0;
      const tasksSolved = entry?.tasksSolved ?? 0;
      const focusMinutes = entry?.focusMinutes ?? 0;
      const total = reviews + tasksSolved;

      let level: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 = 0;
      if (total > 0) {
        const ratio = total / goal;
        if (ratio >= 1) level = 4;
        else if (ratio >= 0.65) level = 3;
        else if (ratio >= 0.3) level = 2;
        else level = 1;
      }

      const label = d.toLocaleDateString('ru-RU', {
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short',
      });
      list.push({key, label, total, reviews, tasksSolved, focusMinutes, level});
    }
    return list;
  }, [activityLog, plannerSettings.dailyGoal]);

  const chapterStats = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<
      QuestionChapter,
      {total: number; known: number; weighted: number; lapses: number}
    >();

    for (const c of allCards) {
      const sr = getCardSRState(srMap, c.id);
      const curr = map.get(c.chapter) ?? {
        total: 0,
        known: 0,
        weighted: 0,
        lapses: 0,
      };
      curr.total += 1;
      if (sr.status === 'known') {
        curr.known += 1;
        curr.weighted += 1;
      } else if (sr.status === 'learning') {
        curr.weighted += 0.55;
      } else if (sr.status === 'hard') {
        curr.weighted += 0.2;
      }
      curr.lapses += sr.lapses;
      map.set(c.chapter, curr);
    }

    const rows = Array.from(map.entries()).map(([chapter, stat]) => {
      const pct = Math.round((stat.weighted / Math.max(1, stat.total)) * 100);
      return {
        chapter,
        total: stat.total,
        known: stat.known,
        lapses: stat.lapses,
        pct,
      };
    });

    let weakestChapter: QuestionChapter | null = null;
    if (rows.length > 0) {
      const sorted = [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.pct !== b.pct) return a.pct - b.pct;
        return b.lapses - a.lapses;
      });
      if (sorted[0].pct < 100) {
        weakestChapter = sorted[0].chapter;
      }
    }

    return {rows, weakestChapter};
  }, [allCards, srMap]);

  const dailyPct = Math.min(
    100,
    Math.round((todayTotal / Math.max(1, plannerSettings.dailyGoal)) * 100),
  );

  const heatColor = (level: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4) => {
    switch (level) {
      case 0:
        return 'bg-slate-200/70 dark:bg-[#131B2B] border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.06]';
      case 1:
        return 'bg-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/90 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800/70';
      case 2:
        return 'bg-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-800/80 border-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-600/70';
      case 3:
        return 'bg-teal-400 dark:bg-emerald-500/85 border-teal-500 dark:border-emerald-400/80';
      case 4:
        return 'bg-cyan-500 dark:bg-cyan-400 border-cyan-600 dark:border-lime-300/80';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="pt-4 mt-4 border-t border-slate-200/70 dark:border-white/[0.07] grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4">
      {/* Column 1: Exam Date Quota + 28-Day Heatmap */}
      <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
        <div className="prism-subpanel rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
              План подготовки до {displayTargetName}
            </span>
            <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">
              <span>Дата:</span>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={examDateIso}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  if (e.target.value) {
                    onUpdateExamDate(category, e.target.value);
                  }
                }}

                      )}
                      <span className="font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">

                    <div
                      className={`h-full transition-all duration-200 ${
                        row.pct >= 75
                          ? 'prism-progress-fill'
                          : row.pct >= 35
                            ? 'bg-cyan-400'
                            : 'bg-rose-500'
                      }`}
                      style={{width: `${row.pct}%`}}
                    />
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
