## FILE: src/hooks/usePWAInstall.ts

```ts
import {useEffect, useState} from 'react';

interface BeforeInstallPromptEvent extends Event {
  prompt: () => Promise<void>;
  userChoice: Promise<{outcome: 'accepted' | 'dismissed'; platform: string}>;
}

export function usePWAInstall() {
  const [deferredPrompt, setDeferredPrompt] =
    useState<BeforeInstallPromptEvent | null>(null);
  const [isInstalled, setIsInstalled] = useState(false);
  const [isIOS, setIsIOS] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const isStandalone =
      window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ||
      (window.navigator as unknown as {standalone?: boolean}).standalone === true;
    setIsInstalled(isStandalone);

    const ua = window.navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();
    setIsIOS(/iphone|ipad|ipod/.test(ua));

    const handleBeforeInstallPrompt = (e: Event) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setDeferredPrompt(e as BeforeInstallPromptEvent);
    };

    const handleAppInstalled = () => {
      setIsInstalled(true);
      setDeferredPrompt(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handleBeforeInstallPrompt);
    window.addEventListener('appinstalled', handleAppInstalled);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(
        'beforeinstallprompt',
        handleBeforeInstallPrompt,
      );
      window.removeEventListener('appinstalled', handleAppInstalled);
    };
  }, []);

  const install = async () => {
    if (!deferredPrompt) return false;
    await deferredPrompt.prompt();
    const {outcome} = await deferredPrompt.userChoice;
    if (outcome === 'accepted') {
      setIsInstalled(true);
      setDeferredPrompt(null);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  };

  return {
    isInstallable: Boolean(deferredPrompt),
    isInstalled,
    isIOS,
    install,
  };
}

export function useOnlineStatus() {
  const [isOnline, setIsOnline] = useState(
    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true,
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOnline = () => setIsOnline(true);
    const handleOffline = () => setIsOnline(false);

    window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
    window.addEventListener('offline', handleOffline);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', handleOnline);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
    };
  }, []);

  return isOnline;
}
```

```ts
export type BuiltinStudyCategory = 'exam' | 'rk' | 'matan';

  | 'exam'
  | 'lec1'
  | 'lec2'
  | 'lec3'
  | 'lec4'
  | 'lec5'
  | 'lec6'
  | 'lec7'
  | 'lec8'
  | 'rk2_angeom'

  | 'matan_metodichka_3';

export type MasteryStatus = 'unseen' | 'hard' | 'learning' | 'known';

/**
 * 4-grade SM-2 / Leitner recall rating:
 * 1 = again («Не помню — повторить сейчас»)
 * 2 = hard  («Сложно — через 10 мин / в конце сессии»)
 * 3 = good  («Хорошо — плановый интервал»)
 * 4 = easy  («Легко — уверенно выучено»)
 */
export type RecallGrade = 'again' | 'hard' | 'good' | 'easy';

export interface CardSRState {
  status: MasteryStatus;
  /** Leitner box 0..4 (0 = again/error, 1 = hard, 2 = good-1, 3 = good-2+, 4 = easy/mastered) */
  box: number;
  /** SM-2 easiness factor (1.3 .. 2.8) */
  easeFactor: number;
  /** Interval in minutes */
  intervalMinutes: number;
  /** Consecutive successful recalls (grade >= good) */
  repetitions: number;
  /** Number of times rated 'again' or failed in quiz */
  lapses: number;
  /** Timestamp (ms) of last review */
  lastReviewedAt?: number;
  /** Timestamp (ms) when next review is due */
  nextReviewAt?: number;
  /** Last recall grade */
  lastGrade?: RecallGrade;
}

export type QuestionChapter =
  | 'Глава 1 · Простейшие конструкции и ввод-вывод'
  | 'Глава 2 · Управляющие конструкции'
  | 'Глава 3 · Массивы, указатели, строки и структуры'
  | 'Глава 4 · Модульное программирование и рекурсия'
  | 'Глава 5 · Динамические списки и очереди'
  | 'Глава 6 · Работа с файлами и кодировки'
  | 'Глава 8 · Деревья и разбор выражений'
  | 'РК 2 · Базовые теоретические вопросы'
  | 'РК 2 · Теория повышенной сложности (доказательства)'
  | 'РК 2 · Задачи и типовой билет'
  | 'Матан · Базовые определения (1–48)'
  | 'Матан · Пределы и б.м.ф. (вопр. 1–15)'
  | 'Матан · Непрерывность и разрывы (вопр. 16–22)'
  | 'Матан · Производная и дифференциал (вопр. 23–29)'
  | 'Матан · Теоремы о среднем, Лопиталь и Тейлор (вопр. 30–42)'
  | 'Матан · Монотонность, экстремумы и выпуклость (вопр. 43–49)'
  | 'Матан · Методички МГТУ (Ч.1–3 · алгоритмы и таблицы)'
  | (string & {});

export interface SlideAttachment {
  lectureId: LectureId;
  /** 1-indexed PDF page number */
  page: number;
  label: string;
  /** True when the slide shows the terminal result, worked answer, or exam task text */
  isAnswerSlide?: boolean;
}

export interface LectureDoc {
  id: LectureId;
  category?: StudyCategory;
  shortTitle: string;
  title: string;
  chapterLabel: string;
  dateLabel: string;
  pageCount: number;
  url: string;
  topics: string[];
}

export type CoverageStatus = 'full' | 'supplemented' | 'lecture-extra' | 'custom';

export interface TheoryCard {
  /** Question number: 1..50 official exam questions, 51..62 lecture deep-dive topics, 201..249 RK-2 cards, 100+ user custom cards */
  id: number;
  /** Category: 'exam' (АИП) or 'rk' (Рубежный контроль 2 · Аналитическая геометрия) */
  category?: StudyCategory;
  /** Display badge label (e.g., "Базовый вопрос №1", "Повыш. сложность №3", "Задача №1") */
  badgeLabel?: string;
  /** Question or term title */
  question: string;
  chapter: QuestionChapter;
  /** Concise short-answer lead to recite first on an oral/written exam (rendered bold on back) */
  keyThesis: string;
  /** Structured bullet points for memorization */
  answerPoints: string[];
  /** Authentic C/C++, RBNF, or mathematical derivation snippet */
  codeSnippet?: {
    title: string;
    code: string;
  };
  /** Optional KaTeX formula block for clean academic math rendering on theory cards (no IDE terminal look) */
  mathFormulaLatex?: string;
  /** Common traps or examiner follow-up points */
  examTip: string;
  /** Short hint for active recall before flipping the card */
  hint?: string;
  /** Key term or construct for active text-input self-testing in Blitz Quiz */
  quizKeyword?: string;
  /** Lecture and slide attachments (with answer/example slides marked) */
  slides: SlideAttachment[];
  coverage: CoverageStatus;
  /** Explicit audit note when slides cover a concept briefly and formula/case completion is provided */
  coverageNote?: string;
  /** True for user-created cards */
  isCustom?: boolean;
}
```

## FILE: src/utils/cardHelpers.ts

```ts
import {
  AppPreferences,
  CardSRState,
  CustomSubject,
  DailyActivityMap,
  MasteryStatus,
  QuizStats,
  StudyCategory,
  StudyPlannerSettings,
  StudyProgressBackup,
  TaskMasteryStatus,
  TheoryCard,
} from '../types/study';
import {DEFAULT_SR_STATE} from './spacedRepetition';

export const STORAGE_KEYS = {
  THEME: 'aip_exam_theme_v1',
  CATEGORY: 'aip_exam_category_v1',
  SR_MAP: 'aip_exam_sr_v2',
  LEGACY_MASTERY: 'aip_exam_mastery_v1',
  CUSTOM_CARDS: 'aip_exam_custom_cards_v1',
  CUSTOM_SUBJECTS: 'aip_exam_custom_subjects_v1',
  QUIZ_STATS: 'aip_exam_quiz_stats_v1',
  TASK_MASTERY: 'aip_exam_task_mastery_v1',
  CARD_NOTES: 'aip_exam_card_notes_v1',
  ACTIVITY_LOG: 'aip_exam_activity_log_v1',
  PLANNER: 'aip_exam_planner_v1',
  REWARDS: 'aip_exam_rewards_v1',
  PREFERENCES: 'aip_exam_preferences_v1',
} as const;

export function getLocalDateKey(date = new Date()): string {
  const y = date.getFullYear();
  const m = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const d = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}

export function addDaysToDateKey(daysFromToday: number): string {
  const dt = new Date();
  dt.setDate(dt.getDate() + daysFromToday);
  return getLocalDateKey(dt);
}

export function loadInitialCategory(): StudyCategory {
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CATEGORY);
    if (
      saved === 'rk' ||
      saved === 'exam' ||
      saved === 'matan' ||
      (typeof saved === 'string' && saved.startsWith('custom_'))
    ) {
      return saved as StudyCategory;
    }
  } catch {
    // ignore storage errors
  }
  return 'matan';
}

export function loadCustomSubjects(): CustomSubject[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOM_SUBJECTS);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
    return parsed.filter(
      (s): s is CustomSubject =>
        Boolean(
          s &&
            typeof s.id === 'string' &&
            s.id.startsWith('custom_') &&
            typeof s.name === 'string' &&
            typeof s.shortName === 'string' &&
            Array.isArray(s.cards),
        ),
    );
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export const DEFAULT_PLANNER_SETTINGS: StudyPlannerSettings = {
  examDates: {
    rk: addDaysToDateKey(7),
    exam: addDaysToDateKey(21),
    matan: addDaysToDateKey(14),
  },
  dailyGoal: 15,
  pomodoroMode: '25/5',
};

export function loadTaskMastery(): Record<string, TaskMasteryStatus> {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TASK_MASTERY);
    if (!raw) return {};
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const clean: Record<string, TaskMasteryStatus> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(parsed)) {
      if (v === 'unsolved' || v === 'hint' || v === 'solved') {
        clean[k] = v;
      }
    }
    return clean;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export function loadCardNotes(): Record<number, string> {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CARD_NOTES);
    if (!raw) return {};
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const clean: Record<number, string> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(parsed)) {
      const id = Number(k);
      if (Number.isInteger(id) && typeof v === 'string' && v.trim()) {
        clean[id] = v;
      }
    }
    return clean;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export function loadActivityLog(): DailyActivityMap {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.ACTIVITY_LOG);
    if (!raw) return {};
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const clean: DailyActivityMap = {};
    for (const [dateKey, val] of Object.entries(parsed)) {
      if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dateKey) && val && typeof val === 'object') {
        const entry = val as Partial<{
          reviews: number;
          tasksSolved: number;
          focusMinutes: number;
        }>;
        clean[dateKey] = {
          reviews: Math.max(0, Number(entry.reviews) || 0),
          tasksSolved: Math.max(0, Number(entry.tasksSolved) || 0),
          focusMinutes: Math.max(0, Number(entry.focusMinutes) || 0),
        };
      }
    }
    return clean;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export function loadPlannerSettings(): StudyPlannerSettings {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PLANNER);
    if (!raw) return DEFAULT_PLANNER_SETTINGS;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<StudyPlannerSettings>;
    const mergedDates: Record<string, string> = {
      ...DEFAULT_PLANNER_SETTINGS.examDates,
    };
    if (parsed.examDates && typeof parsed.examDates === 'object') {
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(parsed.examDates)) {
        if (typeof v === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)) {
          mergedDates[k] = v;
        }
      }
    }
    return {
      examDates: mergedDates,
      dailyGoal:
        typeof parsed.dailyGoal === 'number' &&
        parsed.dailyGoal >= 5 &&
        parsed.dailyGoal <= 100
          ? Math.round(parsed.dailyGoal)
          : DEFAULT_PLANNER_SETTINGS.dailyGoal,
      pomodoroMode: parsed.pomodoroMode === '50/10' ? '50/10' : '25/5',
    };
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_PLANNER_SETTINGS;
  }
}

export const DEFAULT_APP_PREFERENCES: AppPreferences = {
  snowEnabled: true,
  warmGlowEnabled: true,
  confettiEnabled: true,
  showXpInHeader: true,
  focusMinutes: 25,
  breakMinutes: 5,
  autoSaveJsonEnabled: false,
  autoSaveIntervalMinutes: 15,
};

export function sanitizeAppPreferences(
  raw: Partial<AppPreferences> | null | undefined,
): AppPreferences {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') {
    return {...DEFAULT_APP_PREFERENCES};
  }
  const focusMinutes =
    typeof raw.focusMinutes === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw.focusMinutes)
      ? Math.max(5, Math.min(120, Math.round(raw.focusMinutes)))
      : DEFAULT_APP_PREFERENCES.focusMinutes;
  const breakMinutes =
    typeof raw.breakMinutes === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw.breakMinutes)
      ? Math.max(1, Math.min(45, Math.round(raw.breakMinutes)))
      : DEFAULT_APP_PREFERENCES.breakMinutes;
  const autoSaveIntervalMinutes =
    typeof raw.autoSaveIntervalMinutes === 'number' &&
    Number.isFinite(raw.autoSaveIntervalMinutes)
      ? Math.max(1, Math.min(240, Math.round(raw.autoSaveIntervalMinutes)))
      : DEFAULT_APP_PREFERENCES.autoSaveIntervalMinutes;

  return {
    snowEnabled:
      typeof raw.snowEnabled === 'boolean'
        ? raw.snowEnabled
        : DEFAULT_APP_PREFERENCES.snowEnabled,
    warmGlowEnabled:
      typeof raw.warmGlowEnabled === 'boolean'
        ? raw.warmGlowEnabled
        : DEFAULT_APP_PREFERENCES.warmGlowEnabled,
    confettiEnabled:
      typeof raw.confettiEnabled === 'boolean'
        ? raw.confettiEnabled
        : DEFAULT_APP_PREFERENCES.confettiEnabled,
    showXpInHeader:
      typeof raw.showXpInHeader === 'boolean'
        ? raw.showXpInHeader
        : DEFAULT_APP_PREFERENCES.showXpInHeader,
    focusMinutes,
    breakMinutes,
    autoSaveJsonEnabled:
      typeof raw.autoSaveJsonEnabled === 'boolean'
        ? raw.autoSaveJsonEnabled
        : DEFAULT_APP_PREFERENCES.autoSaveJsonEnabled,
    autoSaveIntervalMinutes,
    lastAutoSaveAt:
      typeof raw.lastAutoSaveAt === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw.lastAutoSaveAt)
        ? raw.lastAutoSaveAt
        : undefined,
  };
}

export function loadAppPreferences(): AppPreferences {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PREFERENCES);
    if (!raw) {
      // Seed initial focus/break from existing plannerSettings.pomodoroMode if present
      const planner = loadPlannerSettings();
      return {
        ...DEFAULT_APP_PREFERENCES,
        focusMinutes: planner.pomodoroMode === '50/10' ? 50 : 25,
        breakMinutes: planner.pomodoroMode === '50/10' ? 10 : 5,
      };
    }
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<AppPreferences>;
    return sanitizeAppPreferences(parsed);
  } catch {
    return {...DEFAULT_APP_PREFERENCES};
  }
}

export function computeActivityStreaks(
  activityLog: DailyActivityMap,
  dailyGoal: number,
): {
  todayTotal: number;
  currentStreak: number;
  bestStreak: number;
  totalFocusMinutes: number;
} {
  const todayKey = getLocalDateKey();
  const getTotal = (key: string) => {
    const e = activityLog[key];
    return e ? e.reviews + e.tasksSolved : 0;
  };
  const todayTotal = getTotal(todayKey);

  // Current streak: consecutive days ending today (or yesterday if today isn't completed yet)
  let currentStreak = 0;
  const cursor = new Date();
  if (todayTotal === 0) {
    cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 365; i++) {
    const key = getLocalDateKey(cursor);
    if (getTotal(key) > 0) {
      currentStreak++;
      cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1);
    } else {
      break;
    }
  }

  // Best streak across recorded dates
  const activeDates = Object.keys(activityLog)
    .filter((k) => getTotal(k) > 0)
    .sort();
  let bestStreak = currentStreak;
  let running = 0;
  let prevTime: number | null = null;
  for (const key of activeDates) {
    const t = new Date(`${key}T12:00:00`).getTime();
    if (prevTime !== null && Math.round((t - prevTime) / 86400000) === 1) {
      running++;
    } else {
      running = 1;
    }
    if (running > bestStreak) bestStreak = running;
    prevTime = t;
  }

  let totalFocusMinutes = 0;
  for (const entry of Object.values(activityLog)) {
    totalFocusMinutes += entry.focusMinutes || 0;
  }

  void dailyGoal;
  return {todayTotal, currentStreak, bestStreak, totalFocusMinutes};
}

export function getCardHint(card: TheoryCard): string {
  if (card.hint) {
    return card.hint;
  }
  const firstPoint = card.answerPoints[0] ?? '';
  const slideHint = card.slides[0]
    ? `Опорный слайд: «${card.slides[0].label}» (с. ${card.slides[0].page}).`
    : '';
  const shortLead =
    firstPoint.length > 110 ? `${firstPoint.slice(0, 110).trim()}...` : firstPoint;
  return `${shortLead} ${slideHint}`.trim();
}

export function getCardQuizPromptAndKeyword(card: TheoryCard): {
  prompt: string;
  keyword: string;
} {
  const mapped = QUESTION_KEYWORDS[card.id];
  if (mapped) {
    return mapped;
  }
  if (card.quizKeyword) {
    return {
      prompt: card.question,
      keyword: card.quizKeyword,
    };
  }
  return {
    prompt: card.question,
    keyword: card.keyThesis.split(/\s+/)[0]?.replace(/[.,:;()]/g, '') || 'C++',
  };
}

export function loadInitialTheme(): 'dark' | 'light' {
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.THEME);
    if (saved === 'light' || saved === 'dark') return saved;
  } catch {
    // ignore storage errors
  }
  return 'dark';
}

export function loadInitialSRMap(): Record<number, CardSRState> {
  try {
    const rawV2 = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.SR_MAP);
    if (rawV2) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(rawV2) as Record<string, CardSRState>;
      const clean: Record<number, CardSRState> = {};
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(parsed)) {
        const id = Number(k);
        if (Number.isInteger(id) && id >= 1 && v && typeof v === 'object') {
          clean[id] = {
            status:
              v.status === 'known' ||
              v.status === 'learning' ||
              v.status === 'hard'
                ? v.status
                : 'unseen',
            box: typeof v.box === 'number' ? Math.max(0, Math.min(4, v.box)) : 0,
            easeFactor:
              typeof v.easeFactor === 'number'
                ? Math.max(1.3, Math.min(2.8, v.easeFactor))
                : 2.5,
            intervalMinutes:
              typeof v.intervalMinutes === 'number' ? v.intervalMinutes : 0,
            repetitions:
              typeof v.repetitions === 'number' ? v.repetitions : 0,
            lapses: typeof v.lapses === 'number' ? v.lapses : 0,
            lastReviewedAt: v.lastReviewedAt,
            nextReviewAt: v.nextReviewAt,
            lastGrade: v.lastGrade,
          };
        }
      }
      return clean;
    }

    // Migrate legacy v1 mastery map if present
    const rawV1 = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LEGACY_MASTERY);
    if (rawV1) {
      const legacy = JSON.parse(rawV1) as Record<string, MasteryStatus>;
      const migrated: Record<number, CardSRState> = {};
      for (const [k, st] of Object.entries(legacy)) {
        const id = Number(k);
        if (
          Number.isInteger(id) &&
          id >= 1 &&
          (st === 'unseen' || st === 'hard' || st === 'learning' || st === 'known')
        ) {
          migrated[id] = {
            ...DEFAULT_SR_STATE,
            status: st,
            box: st === 'known' ? 3 : st === 'learning' ? 2 : st === 'hard' ? 1 : 0,
          };
        }
      }
      return migrated;
    }
  } catch {
    // ignore storage errors
  }
  return {};
}

export function loadCustomCards(): TheoryCard[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOM_CARDS);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
    return parsed.filter(
      (c): c is TheoryCard =>
        Boolean(
          c &&
            typeof c.id === 'number' &&
            typeof c.question === 'string' &&
            typeof c.keyThesis === 'string' &&
            Array.isArray(c.answerPoints),
        ),
    );
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export const DEFAULT_QUIZ_STATS: QuizStats = {
  completedCount: 0,
  totalQuestionsAnswered: 0,
  totalCorrect: 0,
  bestScorePct: 0,
};

export function loadQuizStats(): QuizStats {

    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.QUIZ_STATS);
    if (!raw) return DEFAULT_QUIZ_STATS;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<QuizStats>;
    return {
      completedCount: parsed.completedCount ?? 0,
      totalQuestionsAnswered: parsed.totalQuestionsAnswered ?? 0,
      totalCorrect: parsed.totalCorrect ?? 0,
      bestScorePct: parsed.bestScorePct ?? 0,
      lastPlayedAt: parsed.lastPlayedAt,
    };
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_QUIZ_STATS;
  }
}

export function validateBackupPayload(data: unknown): StudyProgressBackup | null {
  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return null;
  const obj = data as Partial<StudyProgressBackup>;
  if (!obj.srMap || typeof obj.srMap !== 'object') return null;
  return {
    version: 2,
    exportedAt:
      typeof obj.exportedAt === 'string'
        ? obj.exportedAt
        : new Date().toISOString(),
    theme: obj.theme === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark',
    srMap: obj.srMap,
    customCards: Array.isArray(obj.customCards) ? obj.customCards : [],
    quizStats:
      obj.quizStats && typeof obj.quizStats === 'object'
        ? {
            completedCount: Number(obj.quizStats.completedCount) || 0,
            totalQuestionsAnswered:
              Number(obj.quizStats.totalQuestionsAnswered) || 0,
            totalCorrect: Number(obj.quizStats.totalCorrect) || 0,
            bestScorePct: Number(obj.quizStats.bestScorePct) || 0,
            lastPlayedAt: obj.quizStats.lastPlayedAt,
          }
        : DEFAULT_QUIZ_STATS,
    taskMastery:
      obj.taskMastery && typeof obj.taskMastery === 'object'
        ? obj.taskMastery
        : undefined,
    cardNotes:
      obj.cardNotes && typeof obj.cardNotes === 'object'
        ? obj.cardNotes
        : undefined,
    activityLog:
      obj.activityLog && typeof obj.activityLog === 'object'
        ? obj.activityLog
        : undefined,
    plannerSettings:
      obj.plannerSettings && typeof obj.plannerSettings === 'object'
        ? {
            ...DEFAULT_PLANNER_SETTINGS,
            ...obj.plannerSettings,
            examDates: {
              ...DEFAULT_PLANNER_SETTINGS.examDates,
              ...(obj.plannerSettings.examDates ?? {}),
            },
          }
        : undefined,
    customSubjects: Array.isArray(obj.customSubjects)
      ? obj.customSubjects
      : undefined,
    rewardState:
      obj.rewardState && typeof obj.rewardState === 'object'
        ? obj.rewardState
        : undefined,
    preferences:
      obj.preferences && typeof obj.preferences === 'object'
        ? sanitizeAppPreferences(obj.preferences)
        : undefined,
  };
}
```

```ts
import {StudyCategory, TaskCard} from '../types/study';
import {TaskAnswerCheckResult} from './taskAnswerChecker';

export interface GeneratedPracticeTask extends TaskCard {
  isGenerated: true;
  generatorTopic: string;
  formatHint: string;
  placeholder: string;
  checkAnswer: (rawInput: string) => TaskAnswerCheckResult;
}

function randInt(min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1)) + min;
}

function pickNonZero(min: number, max: number): number {
  let n = 0;
  while (n === 0) n = randInt(min, max);
  return n;
}

function gcd(a: number, b: number): number {
  let x = Math.abs(a);
  let y = Math.abs(b);
  while (y !== 0) {
    const t = x % y;
    x = y;
    y = t;
  }
  return x || 1;
}

function formatFracLatex(num: number, den: number): string {
  if (den < 0) {
    num = -num;
    den = -den;
  }
  const g = gcd(num, den);
  const n = num / g;
  const d = den / g;
  if (d === 1) return `${n}`;
  return n < 0 ? `-\\frac{${Math.abs(n)}}{${d}}` : `\\frac{${n}}{${d}}`;
}

function formatFracText(num: number, den: number): string {
  if (den < 0) {
    num = -num;
    den = -den;
  }
  const g = gcd(num, den);
  const n = num / g;
  const d = den / g;
  return d === 1 ? `${n}` : `${n}/${d}`;
}

function parseUserNumber(raw: string): number | null {
  const clean = raw
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/,/g, '.')
    .replace(/−/g, '-')
    .replace(/^[a-zA-Zа-яА-Я]+=/i, '');
  if (!clean) return null;
  if (clean.includes('/')) {
    const parts = clean.split('/');
    if (parts.length !== 2) return null;
    const n = Number(parts[0]);
    const d = Number(parts[1]);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n) || !Number.isFinite(d) || d === 0) return null;
    return n / d;
  }
  const v = Number(clean);
  return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null;
}

function makeNumericChecker(
  target: number,
  displayAnswer: string,
): (rawInput: string) => TaskAnswerCheckResult {
  return (rawInput: string) => {
    const val = parseUserNumber(rawInput);
    if (val === null) {
      return {
        isCorrect: false,
        feedback: `Введите число или дробь (например: ${displayAnswer}).`,
      };
    }
    if (Math.abs(val - target) <= 0.015) {
      return {
        isCorrect: true,
        feedback: `Верно! Точный ответ: ${displayAnswer}.`,
      };
    }
    return {
      isCorrect: false,
      feedback: `Пока не сходится (получено ${val.toFixed(3).replace(/\.?0+$/, '')}). Проверьте знак и сокращение коэффициентов.`,
    };
  };
}

function generateMatanLimit2(seedId: string): GeneratedPracticeTask {
  // lim_{x->a} (x^2 - a^2) / (x^2 + (b - a)x - ab) = 2a / (a + b)
  const a = randInt(1, 5);
  let b = randInt(1, 6);
  if (a + b === 0) b = 2;
  const p = b - a;
  const q = -a * b;
  const num = 2 * a;
  const den = a + b;
  const ansText = formatFracText(num, den);
  const ansLatex = formatFracLatex(num, den);
  const pTerm = p === 0 ? '' : p > 0 ? `+ ${p === 1 ? '' : p}x` : `- ${Math.abs(p) === 1 ? '' : Math.abs(p)}x`;

  return {
    id: seedId,
    isGenerated: true,
    generatorTopic: 'Комплект 1 · Неопределённость 0/0',
    category: 'matan',

    problemStatement: `Вычислить предел lim_{x->${a}} (x^2 - ${a * a}) / (x^2 ${pTerm} ${q})`,
    problemTextClean: `Вычислить предел при x → ${a}:`,
    problemLatex: `\\lim_{x \\to ${a}} \\frac{x^2 - ${a * a}}{x^2 ${pTerm} - ${Math.abs(q)}}`,
    algorithmSummary: `Разложить числитель и знаменатель на множители и сократить общий корень (x − ${a}).`,
    explanationSteps: [
      {
        title: 'Шаг 1 · Разложить числитель и знаменатель',
        detail: `Подстановка x = ${a} даёт 0/0, значит (x − ${a}) — общий множитель:`,
        latex: `\\frac{(x - ${a})(x + ${a})}{(x - ${a})(x + ${b})} = \\frac{x + ${a}}{x + ${b}}`,

  };
}

function generateMatanExtrema5(seedId: string): GeneratedPracticeTask {
  // f(x) = x^3 - 3*a*x^2 + c -> f'(x) = 3x(x - 2a), x_max = 0, x_min = 2a, inflection = a
  const a = randInt(1, 5);
  const c = randInt(-4, 6);
  const xMin = 2 * a;
  const fMin = xMin * xMin * xMin - 3 * a * xMin * xMin + c;
  const cStr = c === 0 ? '' : c > 0 ? `+ ${c}` : `- ${Math.abs(c)}`;

  return {
    id: seedId,
    isGenerated: true,
    generatorTopic: 'Комплект 5 · Точка минимума и перегиба',
    category: 'matan',
    kind: 'matan-5',
    badgeNumber: 'Тренажёр · 5',
    title: 'Найти точку локального минимума кубической функции',
    chapter: 'Матан · Монотонность, экстремумы и выпуклость (вопр. 43–49)',
    problemStatement: `Найти точку локального минимума x_min функции f(x) = x^3 - ${3 * a}x^2 ${cStr}`,
    problemTextClean: 'Найти точку локального минимума x_min функции:',
    problemLatex: `f(x) = x^3 - ${3 * a}x^2 ${cStr}`,
    algorithmSummary: `Найти f′(x) = 3x(x − ${xMin}), проверить знаки f′ и f″(${xMin}) > 0.`,
    explanationSteps: [
      {
        title: 'Шаг 1 · Найти производную и стационарные точки',
        detail: 'Приравниваем первую производную к нулю:',
        latex: `f'(x) = 3x^2 - ${6 * a}x = 3x(x - ${xMin}) = 0 \\implies x_1 = 0,\\; x_2 = ${xMin}`,
      },
      {
        title: 'Шаг 2 · Проверить тип экстремума через f″(x)',
        detail: `f″(x) = 6x − ${6 * a}. В точке x = ${xMin} имеем f″(${xMin}) = ${6 * a} > 0 ⇒ это минимум:`,
        latex: `x_{\\min} = ${xMin}, \\qquad f(x_{\\min}) = ${fMin}, \\qquad x_{\\text{перег}} = ${a}`,
      },
    ],
    code: '',
    expectedOutput: `${xMin}`,
    answerLatex: `x_{\\min} = ${xMin} \\quad (y_{\\min} = ${fMin})`,
    slides: [],
    formatHint: 'Введите абсциссу точки минимума x_min (одно число)',
    placeholder: `Например: ${xMin}`,
    checkAnswer: makeNumericChecker(xMin, `${xMin}`),
  };
}

function generateRkDet2x2(seedId: string): GeneratedPracticeTask {
  const a = pickNonZero(-6, 6);
  const b = pickNonZero(-6, 6);
  const c = pickNonZero(-6, 6);
  const d = pickNonZero(-6, 6);
  const det = a * d - b * c;

  return {
    id: seedId,
    isGenerated: true,
    generatorTopic: 'РК 2 · Определитель 2×2',
    category: 'rk',
    kind: 'rk-basic',

    problemStatement: `Вычислить определитель матрицы [[${a}, ${b}], [${c}, ${d}]]`,
    problemTextClean: 'Вычислить определитель матрицы A:',
    problemLatex: `A = \\begin{pmatrix} ${a} & ${b} \\\\ ${c} & ${d} \\end{pmatrix}`,
    algorithmSummary: 'Использовать формулу det(A) = a₁₁a₂₂ − a₁₂a₂₁.',
    explanationSteps: [
      {
        title: 'Шаг 1 · Раскрыть определитель 2-го порядка',
        detail: 'Перемножаем элементы главной и побочной диагоналей:',
        latex: `\\det A = (${a})\\cdot(${d}) - (${b})\\cdot(${c}) = ${a * d} - (${b * c}) = ${det}`,
      },
    ],
    code: '',
    expectedOutput: `${det}`,
    answerLatex: `\\det A = ${det}`,
    slides: [],
    formatHint: 'Одно целое число',
    placeholder: 'Введите det A...',
    checkAnswer: makeNumericChecker(det, `${det}`),
  };
}

function generateRkDet3x3(seedId: string): GeneratedPracticeTask {
  // Triangular-plus-one row op so arithmetic stays clean and exam-realistic
  const a = pickNonZero(-3, 3);
  const b = randInt(-3, 3);
  const c = randInt(-3, 3);
  const d = randInt(-2, 3);
  const e = pickNonZero(-3, 3);
  const f = randInt(-3, 3);
  const g = randInt(-2, 2);
  const h = randInt(-2, 2);
  const k = pickNonZero(-3, 3);
  const det =
    a * (e * k - f * h) - b * (d * k - f * g) + c * (d * h - e * g);

  return {
    id: seedId,
    isGenerated: true,
    generatorTopic: 'РК 2 · Определитель 3×3',
    category: 'rk',
    kind: 'rk-basic',
    badgeNumber: 'Тренажёр · РК2',
    title: 'Вычислить определитель 3×3 (новые числа)',
    chapter: 'РК 2 · Задачи и типовой билет',
    problemStatement: `Вычислить определитель 3×3`,
    problemTextClean: 'Вычислить определитель 3-го порядка:',
    problemLatex: `\\Delta = \\begin{vmatrix} ${a} & ${b} & ${c} \\\\ ${d} & ${e} & ${f} \\\\ ${g} & ${h} & ${k} \\end{vmatrix}`,
    algorithmSummary: 'Разложить по 1-й строке (или применить правило Саррюса / треугольников).',
    explanationSteps: [
      {
        title: 'Шаг 1 · Разложение по первой строке',
        detail: 'Записываем сумму произведений элементов 1-й строки на их алгебраические дополнения:',
        latex: `\\Delta = (${a})(${e * k - f * h}) - (${b})(${d * k - f * g}) + (${c})(${d * h - e * g}) = ${det}`,
      },
    ],
    code: '',
    expectedOutput: `${det}`,
    answerLatex: `\\Delta = ${det}`,
    slides: [],
    formatHint: 'Целое число',
    placeholder: 'Введите значение определителя...',
    checkAnswer: makeNumericChecker(det, `${det}`),
  };
}

function generateRkCramer(seedId: string): GeneratedPracticeTask {
  // Choose integer solution (x0, y0) and invertible 2x2 matrix A
  const x0 = randInt(-4, 5);
  const y0 = randInt(-4, 5);
  let a = pickNonZero(-3, 4);
  let b = pickNonZero(-3, 4);
  let c = pickNonZero(-3, 4);
  let d = pickNonZero(-3, 4);
  while (a * d - b * c === 0) {
    d = pickNonZero(-4, 4);
  }
  const det = a * d - b * c;
  const rhs1 = a * x0 + b * y0;
  const rhs2 = c * x0 + d * y0;
  const detX = rhs1 * d - b * rhs2;
  const detY = a * rhs2 - rhs1 * c;

  return {
    id: seedId,
    isGenerated: true,
    generatorTopic: 'РК 2 · СЛАУ методом Крамера',
    category: 'rk',
    kind: 'rk-ticket',
    badgeNumber: 'Тренажёр · РК2',
    title: 'Решить СЛАУ 2×2 по формулам Крамера (найти x)',
    chapter: 'РК 2 · Задачи и типовой билет',
    problemStatement: `Решить систему ${a}x + ${b}y = ${rhs1}, ${c}x + ${d}y = ${rhs2} и найти x`,
    problemTextClean: 'Решить систему методом Крамера и указать значение x:',
    problemLatex: `\\begin{cases} ${a}x ${b >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${Math.abs(b)}y = ${rhs1}, \\\\ ${c}x ${d >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${Math.abs(d)}y = ${rhs2}. \\end{cases}`,
    algorithmSummary: 'Вычислить Δ, Δₓ и Δᵧ; тогда x = Δₓ / Δ, y = Δᵧ / Δ.',
    explanationSteps: [
      {
        title: 'Шаг 1 · Главный определитель Δ',
        detail: 'Проверяем невырожденность системы (Δ ≠ 0):',
        latex: `\\Delta = ${a}\\cdot(${d}) - (${b})\\cdot(${c}) = ${det} \\neq 0`,
      },
      {
        title: 'Шаг 2 · Вспомогательные определители и ответ',
        detail: 'Заменяем 1-й и 2-й столбцы на столбец свободных членов:',
        latex: `\\Delta_x = ${detX},\\; \\Delta_y = ${detY} \\implies x = \\frac{${detX}}{${det}} = ${x0}, \\quad y = \\frac{${detY}}{${det}} = ${y0}`,
      },
    ],
    code: '',
    expectedOutput: `${x0}`,
    answerLatex: `x = ${x0}, \\qquad y = ${y0}`,
    slides: [],
    formatHint: 'Введите найденное значение x (целое число)',
    placeholder: `Например: ${x0}`,
    checkAnswer: makeNumericChecker(x0, `${x0} (полное решение: x = ${x0}, y = ${y0})`),
  };
}

export function generateInfinitePracticeTask(
  category: StudyCategory,
  preferredKind?: string,
): GeneratedPracticeTask {
  const uid = `gen-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000)}`;

  if (category === 'rk') {
    const rkGens = [generateRkDet2x2, generateRkDet3x3, generateRkCramer];
    const picked = rkGens[randInt(0, rkGens.length - 1)];
    return picked(uid);
  }

  // Matan (or custom math fallback)
  if (preferredKind === 'matan-1') {
    return Math.random() < 0.5
      ? generateMatanLimit1(uid)
      : generateMatanLimit2(uid);
  }
  if (preferredKind === 'matan-3') {
    return generateMatanContinuity3(uid);
  }
  if (preferredKind === 'matan-4') {
    return generateMatanTaylor4(uid);
  }
  if (preferredKind === 'matan-5') {
    return generateMatanExtrema5(uid);
  }

  const allMatan = [
    generateMatanLimit1,
    generateMatanLimit2,
    generateMatanContinuity3,
    generateMatanTaylor4,
    generateMatanExtrema5,
  ];
  return allMatan[randInt(0, allMatan.length - 1)](uid);
}
```

```ts
export function createDefaultRewardState(): RewardSystemState {
  return {
    balanceXp: 0,
    earnedTodayXp: 0,
    earnedDateKey: getLocalDateKey(),
    totalEarnedXp: 0,
    redeemedTodayIds: [],
    totalRedeemedCount: 0,
    rewards: DEFAULT_REWARDS,
    activeBreak: null,
  };
}

export function loadRewardState(): RewardSystemState {
  const today = getLocalDateKey();
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.REWARDS);
    if (!raw) return createDefaultRewardState();
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<RewardSystemState>;
    const isSameDay = parsed.earnedDateKey === today;
    const rewards =
      Array.isArray(parsed.rewards) && parsed.rewards.length > 0
        ? parsed.rewards
        : DEFAULT_REWARDS;

    const activeBreak =
      parsed.activeBreak &&
      typeof parsed.activeBreak.endsAt === 'number' &&
      parsed.activeBreak.endsAt > Date.now()
        ? parsed.activeBreak
        : null;

    return {
      balanceXp: Math.max(0, Number(parsed.balanceXp) || 0),
      earnedTodayXp: isSameDay
        ? Math.max(0, Number(parsed.earnedTodayXp) || 0)
        : 0,
      earnedDateKey: today,
      totalEarnedXp: Math.max(0, Number(parsed.totalEarnedXp) || 0),
      redeemedTodayIds:
        isSameDay && Array.isArray(parsed.redeemedTodayIds)
          ? parsed.redeemedTodayIds
          : [],
      totalRedeemedCount: Math.max(0, Number(parsed.totalRedeemedCount) || 0),
      rewards,
      activeBreak,
    };
  } catch {
    return createDefaultRewardState();
  }
}

export function applyXpAward(
  prev: RewardSystemState,
  deltaXp: number,
): {next: RewardSystemState; newlyUnlocked: RewardItem | null} {
  const today = getLocalDateKey();
  const isSameDay = prev.earnedDateKey === today;
  const oldBalance = prev.balanceXp;
  const newBalance = oldBalance + Math.max(0, deltaXp);

  // Detect if we just crossed the threshold for a reward!
  const sortedRewards = [...prev.rewards].sort((a, b) => a.costXp - b.costXp);
  const newlyUnlocked =
    sortedRewards.find(
      (r) => oldBalance < r.costXp && newBalance >= r.costXp,
    ) ?? null;

  const next: RewardSystemState = {
    ...prev,
    balanceXp: newBalance,
    earnedTodayXp: (isSameDay ? prev.earnedTodayXp : 0) + Math.max(0, deltaXp),
    earnedDateKey: today,
    totalEarnedXp: prev.totalEarnedXp + Math.max(0, deltaXp),
    redeemedTodayIds: isSameDay ? prev.redeemedTodayIds : [],
  };

  return {next, newlyUnlocked};
}

export function getNextLockedReward(state: RewardSystemState): RewardItem | null {
  const sorted = [...state.rewards].sort((a, b) => a.costXp - b.costXp);
  return sorted.find((r) => state.balanceXp < r.costXp) ?? null;
}

export function getHighestUnlockedReward(
  state: RewardSystemState,
): RewardItem | null {
  const unlocked = state.rewards
    .filter((r) => state.balanceXp >= r.costXp)
    .sort((a, b) => b.costXp - a.costXp);
  return unlocked[0] ?? null;
}
```

```ts
import {CardSRState, MasteryStatus, RecallGrade} from '../types/study';

export const DEFAULT_SR_STATE: CardSRState = {
  status: 'unseen',
  box: 0,
  easeFactor: 2.5,
  intervalMinutes: 0,
  repetitions: 0,
  lapses: 0,
};

export function getCardSRState(
  srMap: Record<number, CardSRState>,
  cardId: number,
): CardSRState {
  return srMap[cardId] ?? DEFAULT_SR_STATE;
}

/**
 * Simplified SM-2 + Leitner spaced repetition update:
 * - 'again' (1): Не помню -> repeat now (1 min), box = 0, status = 'hard', lapses + 1
 * - 'hard'  (2): Сложно -> repeat in 10 min (end of session), box = 1, status = 'hard'
 * - 'good'  (3): Хорошо -> 1 day -> 3 days -> interval * EF, box = 2..3, status = 'learning' or 'known'
 * - 'easy'  (4): Легко -> 4 days -> interval * EF * 1.3, box = 4, status = 'known'
 */
export function computeNextSRState(
  prev: CardSRState | undefined,
  grade: RecallGrade,
  now: number = Date.now(),
): CardSRState {
  const cur = prev ?? DEFAULT_SR_STATE;
  let easeFactor = cur.easeFactor || 2.5;
  let repetitions = cur.repetitions || 0;
  let lapses = cur.lapses || 0;
  let intervalMinutes = 0;
  let box = cur.box || 0;
  let status: MasteryStatus = 'learning';

  if (grade === 'again') {
    repetitions = 0;
    lapses += 1;
    box = 0;
    easeFactor = Math.max(1.3, easeFactor - 0.2);
    intervalMinutes = 1; // повторить сейчас (через 1 мин)
    status = 'hard';
  } else if (grade === 'hard') {
    repetitions = 0;
    box = 1;
    easeFactor = Math.max(1.3, easeFactor - 0.15);
    intervalMinutes = 10; // через 10 мин / в конце сессии
    status = 'hard';
  } else if (grade === 'good') {
    repetitions += 1;
    if (repetitions === 1) {
      intervalMinutes = 24 * 60; // 1 день
      box = 2;
      status = 'learning';
    } else if (repetitions === 2) {
      intervalMinutes = 3 * 24 * 60; // 3 дня
      box = 3;
      status = 'known';
    } else {
      intervalMinutes = Math.round(
        Math.max(3 * 24 * 60, cur.intervalMinutes * easeFactor),
      );
      box = 3;
      status = 'known';
    }
  } else {
    // 'easy'
    repetitions += 1;
    easeFactor = Math.min(2.8, easeFactor + 0.15);
    if (repetitions === 1) {
      intervalMinutes = 4 * 24 * 60; // 4 дня
    } else {
      intervalMinutes = Math.round(
        Math.max(4 * 24 * 60, cur.intervalMinutes * easeFactor * 1.3),
      );
    }
    box = 4;
    status = 'known';
  }

  return {
    status,
    box,
    easeFactor: Number(easeFactor.toFixed(2)),
    intervalMinutes,
    repetitions,
    lapses,
    lastReviewedAt: now,
    nextReviewAt: now + intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000,
    lastGrade: grade,
  };
}

export function formatIntervalLabel(state: CardSRState, now = Date.now()): string {
  if (state.status === 'unseen' || !state.nextReviewAt) {
    return 'Новая карточка';
  }
  const diffMin = Math.round((state.nextReviewAt - now) / 60000);
  if (diffMin <= 0) {
    return 'Пора повторить сейчас';
  }
  if (diffMin < 60) {
    return `Повтор через ${diffMin} мин`;
  }
  const hours = Math.round(diffMin / 60);
  if (hours < 24) {
    return `Повтор через ${hours} ч`;
  }
  const days = Math.round(hours / 24);
  return `Повтор через ${days} дн.`;
}

/**
 * Priority score for SM-2 smart queue:
 * Higher score = should be shown earlier.
 * 1) Overdue / immediate 'again' cards and cards with high lapses come first.
 * 2) Hard / Box 1 cards come next.
 * 3) Unseen cards come next.
 * 4) Known cards not yet due come last.
 */
export function getCardUrgencyScore(state: CardSRState, now = Date.now()): number {
  if (state.status === 'hard') {
    const dueBonus = state.nextReviewAt && state.nextReviewAt <= now ? 500 : 250;
    return 1000 + dueBonus + state.lapses * 80 - state.box * 30;
  }
  if (state.status === 'learning') {
    const dueBonus = state.nextReviewAt && state.nextReviewAt <= now ? 300 : 0;
    return 600 + dueBonus + state.lapses * 50;
  }
  if (state.status === 'unseen') {
    return 400;
  }
  // 'known'
  if (state.nextReviewAt && state.nextReviewAt <= now) {
    return 550 + state.lapses * 30;
  }
  return 100 - state.box * 15;
}

export type CardVisualTier =
  | 'unseen'
  | 'again'
  | 'hard'
  | 'learning'
  | 'known'
  | 'rainbow';

/**
 * Returns 0..100 understanding score for a card so UI can clearly distinguish:
 * - 0%: unseen
 * - ~15%: again («Не помню» — crimson/rose)
 * - ~42%: hard («Сложно» — amber/orange)
 * - ~72%: learning («Хорошо / в процессе» — cyan/sky)
 * - ~88%: known («Выучено» — emerald)
 * - 95..100%: rainbow mastery (box >= 4 / easy / 3+ solid reps)
 */
export function getCardMasteryPercent(state: CardSRState): number {
  if (state.status === 'unseen' && !state.lastGrade) {
    return 0;
  }
  if (state.lastGrade === 'again' || (state.status === 'hard' && state.box === 0)) {
    return Math.max(5, 15 - Math.min(10, state.lapses * 2));
  }
  if (state.lastGrade === 'hard' || state.status === 'hard') {
    return 42;
  }
  if (state.status === 'learning') {
    return state.repetitions >= 2 ? 78 : 72;
  }
  // status === 'known'
  if (state.box >= 4 || state.lastGrade === 'easy') {
    return state.repetitions >= 2 ? 100 : 96;
  }
  if (state.repetitions >= 3 || state.easeFactor >= 2.65) {
    return 95;
  }
  return 88;
}

export function getCardVisualTier(state: CardSRState): CardVisualTier {
  const pct = getCardMasteryPercent(state);
  if (pct >= 95) return 'rainbow';
  if (state.status === 'unseen' && !state.lastGrade) return 'unseen';
  if (state.lastGrade === 'again' || (state.status === 'hard' && state.box === 0)) {
    return 'again';
  }
  if (state.lastGrade === 'hard' || state.status === 'hard') {
    return 'hard';
  }
  if (state.status === 'learning') {
    return 'learning';
  }
  return 'known';
}
```

```ts
import {RecallGrade, TheoryCard} from '../types/study';
import {getCardQuizPromptAndKeyword} from './cardHelpers';

export function isSpeechSynthesisSupported(): boolean {
  return typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window;
}

export function stopSpeaking(): void {
  if (!isSpeechSynthesisSupported()) return;
  try {
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
  } catch {
    // ignore browser speech errors
  }
}

export function speakRussianText(
  text: string,
  onStart?: () => void,
  onEnd?: () => void,
  rate = 1.02,
): void {
  if (!isSpeechSynthesisSupported()) {
    onEnd?.();
    return;
  }
  try {
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    const cleaned = text
      .replace(/!==|!=/g, ' не равно ')
      .replace(/==/g, ' равно ')
      .replace(/->/g, ' стрелка ')
      .replace(/::=/g, ' определяется как ')
      .replace(/::/g, ' двойное двоеточие ')
      .replace(/&&/g, ' логическое И ')
      .replace(/\|\|/g, ' логическое ИЛИ ')
      .replace(/[«»"`]/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim();

    const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(cleaned);
    utterance.lang = 'ru-RU';
    utterance.rate = Math.max(0.7, Math.min(1.6, rate));

    const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
    const ruVoice =
      voices.find((v) => v.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith('ru') && v.localService) ??
      voices.find((v) => v.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith('ru'));
    if (ruVoice) {
      utterance.voice = ruVoice;
    }

    utterance.onstart = () => onStart?.();
    utterance.onend = () => onEnd?.();
    utterance.onerror = () => onEnd?.();

    window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
  } catch {
    onEnd?.();
  }
}

export function buildCardAnswerSpeechText(card: TheoryCard): string {
  const points = card.answerPoints.join(' ');
  return `Главный тезис: ${card.keyThesis}. Основные пункты ответа: ${points}. На экзамене обратите внимание: ${card.examTip}`;
}

/* Web Speech API SpeechRecognition type declarations */
export interface BrowserSpeechRecognitionEvent {
  resultIndex: number;
  results: {
    length: number;
    [index: number]: {
      isFinal: boolean;
      0: {transcript: string};
    };
  };
}

export interface BrowserSpeechRecognitionErrorEvent {
  error: string;
}

export interface BrowserSpeechRecognition {
  lang: string;
  continuous: boolean;
  interimResults: boolean;
  start: () => void;
  stop: () => void;
  abort: () => void;
  onresult: ((e: BrowserSpeechRecognitionEvent) => void) | null;
  onerror: ((e: BrowserSpeechRecognitionErrorEvent) => void) | null;
  onend: (() => void) | null;
}

export function createSpeechRecognition(): BrowserSpeechRecognition | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  const w = window as unknown as {
    SpeechRecognition?: new () => BrowserSpeechRecognition;
    webkitSpeechRecognition?: new () => BrowserSpeechRecognition;
  };
  const Ctor = w.SpeechRecognition || w.webkitSpeechRecognition;
  if (!Ctor) return null;
  try {
    const rec = new Ctor();
    rec.lang = 'ru-RU';
    rec.continuous = true;
    rec.interimResults = true;
    return rec;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function blobToBase64(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      const res = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      const commaIdx = res.indexOf(',');
      resolve(commaIdx >= 0 ? res.slice(commaIdx + 1) : res);
    };
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read audio blob'));
    reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });
}

function delayMs(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

export type MicrophonePermissionState =
  | 'granted'
  | 'prompt'
  | 'denied'
  | 'unknown';

/**
 * Explicitly checks the browser's microphone permission state via the Permissions API.
 */
export async function queryMicrophonePermissionState(): Promise<MicrophonePermissionState> {
  if (
    typeof navigator === 'undefined' ||
    !navigator.permissions ||
    typeof navigator.permissions.query !== 'function'
  ) {
    return 'unknown';
  }
  try {
    const status = await navigator.permissions.query({
      name: 'microphone' as PermissionName,
    });
    if (
      status.state === 'granted' ||
      status.state === 'prompt' ||
      status.state === 'denied'
    ) {
      return status.state;
    }
    return 'unknown';
  } catch {
    return 'unknown';
  }
}

/**
 * Subscribes to live changes in microphone permission state (e.g. when the user
 * grants access in the address bar or browser prompt).
 */
export async function subscribeToMicrophonePermission(
  onChange: (state: MicrophonePermissionState) => void,
): Promise<() => void> {
  if (
    typeof navigator === 'undefined' ||
    !navigator.permissions ||
    typeof navigator.permissions.query !== 'function'
  ) {
    return () => {};
  }
  try {
    const status = await navigator.permissions.query({
      name: 'microphone' as PermissionName,
    });
    onChange(status.state as MicrophonePermissionState);
    const listener = () => {
      onChange(status.state as MicrophonePermissionState);
    };
    status.addEventListener?.('change', listener);
    return () => {
      status.removeEventListener?.('change', listener);
    };
  } catch {
    return () => {};
  }
}

export interface AcquireMicResult {
  stream: MediaStream | null;
  permissionState: MicrophonePermissionState;
  errorName?: string;
}

/**
 * Requests a live audio MediaStream via `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia`
 * with an explicit permission check and multi-step retry mechanism:
 * - Attempt 1: Enhanced voice constraints (echoCancellation, noiseSuppression, autoGainControl)
 * - Attempt 2: Bare `{ audio: true }` fallback after a short settling delay
 * - Attempt 3: Re-checks `queryMicrophonePermissionState()`; if permission was just granted
 *   or is still promptable, waits and retries `{ audio: true }` so recently granted permissions
 *   never fail silently or trigger a false 'access denied' warning.
 */
export async function acquireMicrophoneStreamWithRetry(
  maxAttempts = 3,
  onPermissionChange?: (state: MicrophonePermissionState) => void,
): Promise<AcquireMicResult> {
  let permState = await queryMicrophonePermissionState();
  onPermissionChange?.(permState);

  if (
    typeof navigator === 'undefined' ||
    !navigator.mediaDevices ||
    typeof navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia !== 'function'
  ) {
    return {
      stream: null,
      permissionState: permState,
      errorName: 'NotSupportedError',
    };
  }

  const constraintSequence: MediaStreamConstraints[] = [
    {
      audio: {
        echoCancellation: true,
        noiseSuppression: true,
        autoGainControl: true,
      },
    },
    {audio: true},
    {audio: true},
  ];

  let lastErrorName = '';

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < maxAttempts; attempt++) {
    const constraints =
      constraintSequence[Math.min(attempt, constraintSequence.length - 1)];

    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(constraints);
      const hasLiveTrack = stream
        .getAudioTracks()
        .some((t) => t.readyState === 'live' || t.enabled);

      if (hasLiveTrack) {
        onPermissionChange?.('granted');
        return {
          stream,
          permissionState: 'granted',
        };
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const domErr = err as {name?: string};
      lastErrorName = domErr?.name || 'UnknownError';
    }

    // Re-check explicit permission state after an attempt fails
    permState = await queryMicrophonePermissionState();
    onPermissionChange?.(permState);

    // Wait briefly before retrying (gives browser audio subsystem time to settle after user clicks "Allow")
    if (attempt < maxAttempts - 1) {
      await delayMs(280 * (attempt + 1));
    }
  }

  // Final check: if permission is actually 'granted', try one last bare getUserMedia call
  const finalPerm = await queryMicrophonePermissionState();
  onPermissionChange?.(finalPerm);
  if (finalPerm === 'granted') {
    try {
      await delayMs(250);
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio: true});
      return {
        stream,
        permissionState: 'granted',
      };
    } catch (err) {
      const domErr = err as {name?: string};
      lastErrorName = domErr?.name || lastErrorName;
    }
  }

  return {
    stream: null,
    permissionState: finalPerm,
    errorName: lastErrorName,
  };
}

export interface HybridVoiceRecorderCallbacks {
  initialText: string;
  questionContext?: string;
  onLiveText: (text: string) => void;
  onTranscribingChange?: (isTranscribing: boolean) => void;
  onPermissionStateChange?: (state: MicrophonePermissionState) => void;
  onError: (message: string) => void;
  onStop?: () => void;
}

export interface HybridVoiceRecorderHandle {
  stop: () => Promise<string>;
}

/**
 * Starts a reliable hybrid microphone session:
 * 1. Acquires real microphone stream via `acquireMicrophoneStreamWithRetry` (`getUserMedia` with retry
 *    and explicit permission state checks) and records via `MediaRecorder`.
 * 2. Runs `SpeechRecognition` in parallel for live preview text while speaking, with automatic retry
 *    if `SpeechRecognition` initially fires `not-allowed` right after permission was granted.
 * 3. Never displays a false 'access denied' error when `getUserMedia` or `navigator.permissions`
 *    confirms microphone access is granted.
 */
export async function startHybridVoiceRecording(
  callbacks: HybridVoiceRecorderCallbacks,
): Promise<HybridVoiceRecorderHandle | null> {
  const prefix = callbacks.initialText.trim()
    ? `${callbacks.initialText.trim()} `
    : '';
  let liveCommitted = '';
  let liveInterim = '';
  let mediaStream: MediaStream | null = null;
  let mediaRecorder: MediaRecorder | null = null;
  const audioChunks: BlobPart[] = [];
  let recognition: BrowserSpeechRecognition | null = null;
  let recognitionRetried = false;
  let stopped = false;

  // Step 1: Acquire real microphone stream with retry and explicit permission state check
  const micResult = await acquireMicrophoneStreamWithRetry(
    3,
    callbacks.onPermissionStateChange,
  );
  mediaStream = micResult.stream;

  if (mediaStream && typeof MediaRecorder !== 'undefined') {
    const attachDataHandler = (rec: MediaRecorder) => {
      rec.ondataavailable = (ev) => {
        if (ev.data && ev.data.size > 0) {
          audioChunks.push(ev.data);
        }
      };
    };

    try {
      const preferredMime = MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(
        'audio/webm;codecs=opus',
      )
        ? 'audio/webm;codecs=opus'
        : MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('audio/webm')
          ? 'audio/webm'
          : MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('audio/mp4')
            ? 'audio/mp4'
            : '';

      mediaRecorder = preferredMime
        ? new MediaRecorder(mediaStream, {mimeType: preferredMime})
        : new MediaRecorder(mediaStream);
      attachDataHandler(mediaRecorder);
      mediaRecorder.start(250);
    } catch {
      // Fallback: instantiate MediaRecorder with default browser settings so mediaStream is never wasted
      try {
        mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(mediaStream);
        attachDataHandler(mediaRecorder);
        mediaRecorder.start(250);
      } catch {
        mediaRecorder = null;
      }
    }
  }

  // Step 2: Also start browser SpeechRecognition if available for instant live preview
  const setupAndStartRecognition = () => {
    const rec = createSpeechRecognition();
    if (!rec) return null;

    rec.onresult = (event) => {
      let interim = '';
      let finalChunk = '';
      for (let i = event.resultIndex; i < event.results.length; i++) {
        const res = event.results[i];
        if (res.isFinal) {
          finalChunk += `${res[0].transcript} `;
        } else {
          interim += res[0].transcript;
        }
      }
      if (finalChunk) {
        liveCommitted += finalChunk;
      }
      liveInterim = interim;
      const combined = `${prefix}${liveCommitted}${liveInterim}`.trimStart();
      if (combined) {
        callbacks.onLiveText(combined);
      }
    };

    rec.onerror = async (err) => {
      if (stopped) return;

      const hasActiveStream =
        Boolean(mediaStream && mediaStream.active) ||
        Boolean(mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state !== 'inactive');

      const latestPerm = await queryMicrophonePermissionState();
      callbacks.onPermissionStateChange?.(latestPerm);

      // If permission was just granted (or MediaRecorder is actively capturing audio),
      // do NOT fail or show a false "access denied" warning!
      if (hasActiveStream || latestPerm === 'granted') {
        if (
          !recognitionRetried &&
          (err.error === 'not-allowed' || err.error === 'service-not-allowed')
        ) {
          recognitionRetried = true;
          await delayMs(350);
          if (!stopped) {
            try {
              recognition = setupAndStartRecognition();
            } catch {
              // MediaRecorder continues capturing audio for server transcription
            }
          }
        }
        return;
      }

      if (err.error === 'not-allowed' || err.error === 'service-not-allowed') {
        callbacks.onError(
          'Доступ к микрофону ещё не подтверждён браузером. Нажмите «Повторить подключение к микрофону» или проверьте значок микрофона в адресной строке.',
        );
      }
    };

    try {
      rec.start();
      return rec;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  };

  recognition = setupAndStartRecognition();

  // Step 3: Verify we have at least one active capture path or handle recently granted permission
  const finalPermCheck = await queryMicrophonePermissionState();
  callbacks.onPermissionStateChange?.(finalPermCheck);

  if (!mediaStream && !mediaRecorder && !recognition) {
    if (finalPermCheck === 'granted') {
      callbacks.onError(
        'Разрешение на микрофон получено, но аудиопоток ещё инициализируется. Нажмите «Повторить подключение к микрофону».',
      );
    } else if (
      micResult.errorName === 'NotFoundError' ||
      micResult.errorName === 'DevicesNotFoundError'
    ) {
      callbacks.onError(
        'Аудиоустройство ввода (микрофон) не найдено в системе. Подключите микрофон или введите ответ текстом.',
      );
    } else {
      callbacks.onError(
        'Не удалось открыть микрофон. Если вы только что разрешили доступ в браузере, нажмите «Повторить подключение к микрофону».',
      );
    }
    return null;
  }

  const stop = async (): Promise<string> => {
    if (stopped) {
      return `${prefix}${liveCommitted}${liveInterim}`.trim();
    }
    stopped = true;

    if (recognition) {
      try {
        recognition.onend = null;
        recognition.stop();
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      recognition = null;
    }

    let recordedBlob: Blob | null = null;
    let recordedMime = 'audio/webm';

    if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state !== 'inactive') {
      recordedMime = mediaRecorder.mimeType || 'audio/webm';
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        if (!mediaRecorder) {
          resolve();
          return;
        }
        mediaRecorder.onstop = () => resolve();
        try {
          mediaRecorder.stop();
        } catch {
          resolve();
        }
      });
      if (audioChunks.length > 0) {
        recordedBlob = new Blob(audioChunks, {type: recordedMime});
      }
    }

    if (mediaStream) {
      for (const track of mediaStream.getTracks()) {
        try {
          track.stop();
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }
      }
      mediaStream = null;
    }

    const browserSpeechText = `${liveCommitted}${liveInterim}`.trim();

    // If browser SpeechRecognition already produced solid text (>= 12 chars), use it immediately
    if (browserSpeechText.length >= 12) {
      const fullText = `${prefix}${browserSpeechText}`.trim();
      callbacks.onLiveText(fullText);
      callbacks.onStop?.();
      return fullText;
    }

    // Otherwise, if we recorded audio via MediaRecorder, transcribe it via server-side Gemini!
    if (recordedBlob && recordedBlob.size > 400) {
      try {
        callbacks.onTranscribingChange?.(true);
        const base64 = await blobToBase64(recordedBlob);
        const resp = await fetch('/api/exam/transcribe', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
          body: JSON.stringify({
            audioBase64: base64,
            mimeType: recordedMime,
            questionContext: callbacks.questionContext,
          }),
        });
        if (resp.ok) {
          const data = (await resp.json()) as {transcript?: string};
          const serverTranscript = (data.transcript ?? '').trim();
          if (serverTranscript) {
            const finalText = `${prefix}${serverTranscript}`.trim();
            callbacks.onLiveText(finalText);
            callbacks.onTranscribingChange?.(false);
            callbacks.onStop?.();
            return finalText;
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // fallback to whatever browserSpeechText had
      } finally {
        callbacks.onTranscribingChange?.(false);
      }
    }

    const finalFallback = `${prefix}${browserSpeechText}`.trim();
    if (finalFallback) {
      callbacks.onLiveText(finalFallback);
    }
    callbacks.onStop?.();
    return finalFallback;
  };

  return {stop};
}

export interface AnswerEvaluationResult {
  scorePct: number;
  recommendedGrade: RecallGrade;
  verdictTitle: string;
  verdictDetail: string;
  matchedKeywords: string[];
  missedKeywords: string[];
  followUpQuestion?: string;
  evaluatedBy?: 'professor-ai' | 'local-fallback';
}

/* Synonym dictionary so even local fallback understands human phrasing */
const SYNONYM_GROUPS: string[][] = [
  ['массив', 'массива', 'индекс', 'элементы подряд', 'непрерывная область'],
  ['указатель', 'адрес', 'разыменование', 'звездочка', 'pointer', 'амперсанд'],
  ['ссылка', 'псевдоним', 'второе имя', 'алиас', 'reference'],
  ['стек', 'lifo', 'последним пришел', 'вершина стека', 'push', 'pop'],
  ['очередь', 'fifo', 'первым пришел', 'начало и конец', 'голова и хвост'],
  ['цикл', 'повторение', 'итерация', 'условие выхода', 'тело цикла'],
  ['предусловие', 'сначала проверяется', 'while', 'до выполнения'],
  ['постусловие', 'сначала выполняется', 'do while', 'хотя бы один раз'],
  ['рекурсия', 'вызов самой себя', 'базовый случай', 'условие остановки'],
  ['структура', 'struct', 'разнотипные поля', 'объединение данных'],
  ['динамическая память', 'куча', 'heap', 'new', 'delete', 'выделение памяти'],
  ['файл', 'поток', 'fstream', 'ifstream', 'ofstream', 'чтение и запись'],
  ['дерево', 'корень', 'узел', 'потомок', 'лист', 'левое и правое'],
  ['функция', 'подпрограмма', 'параметры', 'возвращаемое значение', 'прототип'],
];

function normalizeWord(w: string): string {
  return w.toLowerCase().replace(/ё/g, 'е').trim();
}

function getStem(word: string): string {
  const norm = normalizeWord(word);
  if (/^[a-z0-9_]+$/.test(norm)) {
    return norm;
  }
  if (norm.length >= 7) return norm.slice(0, 5);
  if (norm.length >= 5) return norm.slice(0, 4);
  return norm;
}

/**
 * Local human-toned fallback evaluator (used if backend API is unreachable).
 */
export function evaluateStudentAnswer(
  card: TheoryCard,
  userAnswer: string,
): AnswerEvaluationResult {
  const cleanUser = normalizeWord(userAnswer);
  if (!cleanUser) {
    return {
      scorePct: 0,
      recommendedGrade: 'again',
      verdictTitle: 'В ответ тишина — рекомендуется «1 · Не помню»',
      verdictDetail:
        'Пока вы ничего не ответили. На экзамене лучше начать хотя бы своими словами: объясните, зачем эта конструкция нужна и как она работает.',
      matchedKeywords: [],
      missedKeywords: [],
      evaluatedBy: 'local-fallback',
    };
  }

  const kwObj = getCardQuizPromptAndKeyword(card);
  const referenceSource = normalizeWord(
    `${kwObj.keyword} ${card.keyThesis} ${card.answerPoints.join(' ')}`,
  );

  // Check semantic clauses (thesis + answerPoints)
  const allClauses = [card.keyThesis, ...card.answerPoints.slice(0, 4)];
  const matchedIdeas: string[] = [];
  const missedIdeas: string[] = [];

  for (const clause of allClauses) {
    const clauseNorm = normalizeWord(clause);
    const words =
      clauseNorm
        .match(/[a-zA-Zа-яА-ЯёЁ0-9_]{4,}/g)
        ?.filter((w) => !['которая', 'которые', 'который', 'используется', 'позволяет', 'представляет'].includes(w)) ?? [];

    if (words.length === 0) continue;

    let hits = 0;
    for (const w of words) {
      const stem = getStem(w);
      let matched = cleanUser.includes(stem);
      if (!matched) {
        for (const group of SYNONYM_GROUPS) {
          if (
            group.some((g) => clauseNorm.includes(g)) &&
            group.some((g) => cleanUser.includes(g))
          ) {
            matched = true;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      if (matched) hits++;
    }

    const ratio = hits / Math.max(1, Math.min(words.length, 5));
    const shortLabel =
      clause.length > 68 ? `${clause.slice(0, 65).trim()}...` : clause;

    if (ratio >= 0.32) {
      matchedIdeas.push(shortLabel);
    } else {
      missedIdeas.push(shortLabel);
    }
  }

  const mainKw = normalizeWord(kwObj.keyword);
  const mainHit =
    mainKw.length >= 2 &&
    (cleanUser.includes(mainKw) || cleanUser.includes(getStem(mainKw)));

  // Also check overall synonym/concept overlap
  let bonus = mainHit ? 20 : 0;
  for (const group of SYNONYM_GROUPS) {
    if (
      group.some((g) => referenceSource.includes(g)) &&
      group.some((g) => cleanUser.includes(g))
    ) {
      bonus += 15;
    }
  }

  const ideaRatio = matchedIdeas.length / Math.max(1, allClauses.length);
  const lengthFactor = cleanUser.split(/\s+/).length >= 8 ? 15 : 5;
  const scorePct = Math.min(
    100,
    Math.round(ideaRatio * 80 + bonus + (matchedIdeas.length > 0 ? lengthFactor : 0)),
  );

  if (scorePct >= 76) {
    return {
      scorePct,
      recommendedGrade: 'easy',
      verdictTitle: 'Зачтено уверенно — «4 · Легко»',
      verdictDetail:
        'Отлично! Своими словами, но саму суть и механику работы ты объяснил абсолютно верно. На экзамене за такой ответ я сразу ставлю плюс без лишних вопросов.',
      matchedKeywords: matchedIdeas.slice(0, 4),
      missedKeywords: missedIdeas.slice(0, 2),
      evaluatedBy: 'local-fallback',
    };
  }

  if (scorePct >= 50) {
    return {
      scorePct,
      recommendedGrade: 'good',
      verdictTitle: 'Хорошее понимание сути — «3 · Хорошо»',
      verdictDetail:
        'Главная мысль верная, видно, что тему ты понимаешь. На экзамене я бы ответ засчитал, но попросил бы чуть точнее раскрыть оставшиеся детали ниже.',
      matchedKeywords: matchedIdeas.slice(0, 4),
      missedKeywords: missedIdeas.slice(0, 3),
      evaluatedBy: 'local-fallback',
    };
  }

  if (scorePct >= 24) {
    return {
      scorePct,
      recommendedGrade: 'hard',
      verdictTitle: 'Мысль в верную сторону, но сыро — «2 · Сложно»',
      verdictDetail:
        'Ты зацепил только часть темы, но для уверенного ответа на экзамене не хватает самой механики. Посмотри эталон ниже и давай повторим этот билет через 10 минут.',
      matchedKeywords: matchedIdeas.slice(0, 3),
      missedKeywords: missedIdeas.slice(0, 3),
      evaluatedBy: 'local-fallback',
    };
  }

  return {
    scorePct,
    recommendedGrade: 'again',
    verdictTitle: 'Так билет пока не сдать — «1 · Не помню»',
    verdictDetail:
      'В ответе не раскрыта суть вопроса (или допущена путаница в базовом определении). Разбери главный тезис на обороте карточки и попробуй объяснить его своими словами.',
    matchedKeywords: matchedIdeas.slice(0, 2),
    missedKeywords: missedIdeas.slice(0, 3),
    evaluatedBy: 'local-fallback',
  };
}

/**
 * Calls the server-side Gemini Professor evaluator (`/api/exam/evaluate`)
 * for a strict, fair, human oral-exam assessment, falling back to `evaluateStudentAnswer` if offline.
 */
export async function evaluateStudentAnswerWithProfessor(
  card: TheoryCard,
  userAnswer: string,
): Promise<AnswerEvaluationResult> {
  const clean = userAnswer.trim();
  if (!clean) {
    return evaluateStudentAnswer(card, '');
  }

  try {
    const resp = await fetch('/api/exam/evaluate', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({
        card: {
          id: card.id,
          chapter: card.chapter,
          question: card.question,
          keyThesis: card.keyThesis,
          answerPoints: card.answerPoints,
          examTip: card.examTip,
          codeSnippet: card.codeSnippet,
        },
        userAnswer: clean,
      }),
    });

    if (resp.ok) {
      const data = (await resp.json()) as AnswerEvaluationResult;
      if (data && typeof data.verdictTitle === 'string') {
        return data;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall back to local evaluator on network error
  }

  return evaluateStudentAnswer(card, clean);
}

export interface FollowUpEvaluationResult {
  passed: boolean;
  updatedScorePct: number;
  recommendedGrade: RecallGrade;
  professorReply: string;
}

/**
 * Evaluates a student's 1-round answer to the examiner's follow-up question (`/api/exam/followup`),
 * upgrading the recommended SM-2 grade when the student successfully defends their understanding.
 */
export async function evaluateFollowUpWithProfessor(
  card: TheoryCard,
  initialAnswer: string,
  followUpQuestion: string,
  followUpAnswer: string,
  initialScorePct: number,
): Promise<FollowUpEvaluationResult> {
  const clean = followUpAnswer.trim();
  if (!clean) {
    return {
      passed: false,
      updatedScorePct: initialScorePct,
      recommendedGrade: initialScorePct >= 55 ? 'good' : 'hard',
      professorReply:
        'Ответ на дополнительный вопрос пуст — попробуйте сформулировать короткое пояснение своими словами.',
    };
  }

  try {
    const resp = await fetch('/api/exam/followup', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({
        card: {
          id: card.id,
          question: card.question,
          keyThesis: card.keyThesis,
          answerPoints: card.answerPoints,
          examTip: card.examTip,
        },
        initialAnswer,
        followUpQuestion,
        followUpAnswer: clean,
        initialScorePct,
      }),
    });

    if (resp.ok) {
      const data = (await resp.json()) as FollowUpEvaluationResult;
      if (data && typeof data.professorReply === 'string') {
        return data;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Graceful local fallback if server is unavailable
  }

  const localCheck = evaluateStudentAnswer(card, `${initialAnswer} ${clean}`);
  const wordCount = clean.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  const passed = localCheck.scorePct >= Math.max(45, initialScorePct + 5) || wordCount >= 7;
  const updatedScorePct = passed
    ? Math.min(100, Math.max(initialScorePct + 14, localCheck.scorePct))
    : initialScorePct;
  const recommendedGrade: RecallGrade =
    updatedScorePct >= 82
      ? 'easy'
      : updatedScorePct >= 55
        ? 'good'
        : updatedScorePct >= 28
          ? 'hard'
          : 'again';

  return {
    passed,
    updatedScorePct,
    recommendedGrade,
    professorReply: passed
      ? 'Хорошо, уточнение принято — логика понятна, балл можно повысить.'
      : 'Пока уточнение не до конца закрывает вопрос. Сверьтесь с эталонным ответом на обороте карточки.',
  };
}
```

```ts
export interface TaskAnswerCheckResult {
  isCorrect: boolean;
  feedback: string;
}

export interface TaskAnswerHint {
  placeholder: string;
  formatHint: string;
}

function normalizeMathString(raw: string): string {
  return raw
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[−–—]/g, '-')
    .replace(/ё/g, 'е')
    .replace(/λ/g, 'lambda')
    .replace(/≠/g, '!=')
    .replace(/θ/g, '0')
    .replace(/,/g, '.')
    .trim();
}

/**
 * Extracts ordered numeric values (integers, decimals, and fractions like -1/2 or 2/3)
 * from a free-form student answer string.
 */
function extractNumbers(raw: string): number[] {
  const normalized = raw
    .replace(/[−–—]/g, '-')
    .replace(/(\d),(\d)/g, '$1.$2');
  // Strip variable subscripts like x1, x_2, c1, e_1 so they aren't parsed as answer numbers
  const withoutSubscripts = normalized.replace(
    /\b([xceam]|ранг|rang|det|λ|lambda)_?\d+\b/gi,
    ' ',
  );
  const tokens = withoutSubscripts.match(/-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s*\/\s*-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?/g);
  if (!tokens) return [];

  const nums: number[] = [];
  for (const tok of tokens) {
    if (tok.includes('/')) {
      const [aStr, bStr] = tok.split('/').map((s) => s.trim());
      const a = Number(aStr);
      const b = Number(bStr);
      if (Number.isFinite(a) && Number.isFinite(b) && b !== 0) {
        nums.push(a / b);
      }
    } else {
      const v = Number(tok);
      if (Number.isFinite(v)) nums.push(v);
    }
  }
  return nums;
}

function approxEq(a: number, b: number, eps = 1e-3): boolean {
  return Math.abs(a - b) <= eps;
}

function arraysMatch(actual: number[], expected: number[], eps = 1e-3): boolean {
  if (actual.length !== expected.length) return false;
  return expected.every((val, idx) => approxEq(actual[idx], val, eps));
}

function isNonZeroVector(v: number[]): boolean {
  return v.some((x) => Math.abs(x) > 1e-4);
}

function satisfiesHomogeneousSystem(matrixA: number[][], v: number[]): boolean {
  for (const row of matrixA) {
    let dot = 0;
    for (let j = 0; j < row.length; j++) {
      dot += row[j] * (v[j] ?? 0);
    }
    if (Math.abs(dot) > 1e-2) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function areTwoVectorsIndependent(u: number[], v: number[]): boolean {
  if (!isNonZeroVector(u) || !isNonZeroVector(v)) return false;
  for (let i = 0; i < u.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < u.length; j++) {
      if (Math.abs(u[i] * v[j] - u[j] * v[i]) > 1e-3) {
        return true;
      }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function matrixRank2D(rows: number[][]): number {
  const m = rows.map((r) => [...r]);
  const rowCount = m.length;
  const colCount = m[0]?.length ?? 0;
  let r = 0;
  for (let c = 0; c < colCount && r < rowCount; c++) {
    let pivot = r;
    for (let i = r + 1; i < rowCount; i++) {
      if (Math.abs(m[i][c]) > Math.abs(m[pivot][c])) pivot = i;
    }
    if (Math.abs(m[pivot][c]) < 1e-4) continue;
    [m[r], m[pivot]] = [m[pivot], m[r]];
    const pv = m[r][c];
    for (let j = c; j < colCount; j++) m[r][j] /= pv;
    for (let i = 0; i < rowCount; i++) {
      if (i !== r && Math.abs(m[i][c]) > 1e-4) {
        const factor = m[i][c];
        for (let j = c; j < colCount; j++) m[i][j] -= factor * m[r][j];
      }
    }
    r++;
  }
  return r;
}
```
